title: Glowing Invisible Mobs
description: Automatically applies the Glowing effect to all mobs under the Invisibility effect! 自动为所有处于隐身效果的生物附加发光效果！
body:
**Datapack Name:** Glowing Invisible Mobs

**Description:**

This datapack implements a simple yet highly practical feature: **automatically applies the Glowing effect to all mobs under the Invisibility effect**.

In vanilla Minecraft, invisible mobs become transparent and can be extremely difficult to spot in complex terrain or dark environments. This datapack elegantly solves this issue. Whenever a mob (including players) consumes an Invisibility potion or receives the Invisibility effect, a highly visible glowing outline will immediately appear around them.

**Key Features:**

*   **Automatic Application:** No manual intervention required. The glowing effect is automatically applied to any entity with the Invisibility status effect.
*   **Comprehensive Coverage:** Effective on all mob types, including monsters, animals, villagers, and even other invisible players.
*   **Dynamic Synchronization:** The glowing effect is removed as soon as the invisibility effect wears off, eliminating any lingering outlines.
*   **Vanilla Compatible:** Built entirely using vanilla commands, without modifying core game files. Compatible with most other datapacks and mods.

**Use Cases:**

*   **On Servers:** Balances invisibility tactics in PvP by preventing "perfect stealth" ambushes, promoting fairer combat.
*   **Adventure Maps:** Allows mapmakers to design puzzles or stages that require finding or tracking invisible entities.
*   **Survival Utility:** Easily locate your pets that have wandered off after drinking an invisibility potion (Who knows? ), or quickly find invisible Wandering Traders and Illusioners.

**How It Works:**
*   Continuously scans for all entities in the world. If an entity is detected with the Invisibility status effect, the Glowing effect is simultaneously applied to it.

**In a nutshell:** Never lose track of an invisible foe again!

---

**数据包名称：** 隐身生物发光 / Glowing Invisible Mobs

**功能介绍：**

这个数据包实现了一个简单但非常实用的功能：**自动为所有处于隐身效果的生物附加发光效果**。

在原版 Minecraft 中，隐身的生物由于变得透明，在复杂地形或黑暗环境下难以被发现。这个数据包完美地解决了这个问题。一旦有生物（包括玩家）饮下隐身药水或被施加隐身效果，其周身会立刻出现一个显眼的发光轮廓。

**核心特性：**

*   **自动生效：** 无需手动操作，对任何拥有隐身状态效果的生物自动启用。
*   **全面覆盖：** 对所有生物有效，包括怪物、动物、村民，甚至是其他隐身玩家。
*   **动态同步：** 发光效果会随隐身效果一同消失，无需担心残留的轮廓。
*   **原版兼容：** 完全基于原版命令，不修改游戏核心文件，与绝大多数其他数据包和模组兼容。

**应用场景：**

*   **服务器上：** 在 PvP 竞技时，可以有效地平衡隐身战术，防止“完全隐形”的偷袭，鼓励更公平的对抗。
*   **冒险地图：** 地图作者可以利用此功能设计需要寻找或追踪隐身实体的谜题或关卡。
*   **生存实用：** 轻松找到你那个喝了隐身药水到处乱跑的家养猫狗（？），或者快速定位隐身的流浪商人和幻术师。

**工作原理：**  
* 持续检测世界中的每一个实体，如果检测到其拥有“隐身”状态效果，则同时为其赋予“发光”效果。

**总之：** 再也不用担心找不到隐身的敌人了！

title: Autoborder
description: A autoborder plugin that moves automatically blocks everyday.
body:
# AutoBorder

AutoBorder is a Minecraft (Paper/Spigot) plugin that automatically grows the world border at configurable times and days. The plugin supports broadcasts, titles, sounds, logging, and advanced admin commands. All options are configurable via `config.yml`.

---

## Features

- Automatically grows the world border at set times and days
- Animated border growth
- Optional: chat message, title, and sound for all players when the border grows
- Optional: logs border changes to a file
- Admins can directly change the border, get info, or allow players to move outside the border

---

## Installation

1. Place the plugin JAR in your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Start the server. The `config.yml` will be generated automatically.

---

## Commands

All commands start with `/border`:

| Command                        | Description                                         |
|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| `/border reload`               | Reload the config and immediately update the border |
| `/border set <size>`           | Set the border to a specific size (diameter in blocks) |
| `/border add <amount>`         | Increase the border by a number of blocks           |
| `/border remove <amount>`      | Decrease the border by a number of blocks           |
| `/border center <x> <z>`       | Set the border center to coordinates (x, z)         |
| `/border center here`          | Set the border center to your current location      |
| `/border info`                 | Show current border information                     |
| `/border log`                  | Show the last 10 lines of border.log                |
| `/border bypass [player]`      | Allow yourself or another player to move outside the border |
| `/border help`                 | Overview of all commands                           |

> Only players with the `border.admin` permission can use these commands.

---

## Configuration

All options are found in `config.yml`. Main options include:

- Times and days for border growth
- Animation settings
- Messages, titles, and sounds
- Logging

---

## PlaceholderAPI

Use `%autoborder_size%` to display the current border size.

---

## Questions or bugs?

Contact **JoeyNNL** or open an issue on GitHub.

---

description: the best plugin that allows you to choose a class
body:
PowerPlugin: Unified Class-Based RPG System
PowerPlugin transforms your PaperMC server into a full-fledged class-based RPG. Every player picks (or is assigned) a distinct power class—each with its own strengths, weaknesses, and signature abilities. The plugin is built for Minecraft 1.21.x, relies on a clean event-driven architecture, and is easily extensible.

Architecture Overview
Class Registry A Map<UUID, String> playerClasses stores each player’s chosen class name (“Undead”, “Kiborg”, “Automaton”, “Richman”, etc.).

Resource & Cooldown Trackers

Map<UUID, Double> playerWealth tracks dynamic wealth for the Richman class.

Map<UUID, Long> cooldown maps enforce per-player cooldowns on abilities.

API Versioning Compiled against Paper API 1.21.6-R0.1-SNAPSHOT, with api-version: 1.21 in plugin.yml.

Utility Methods Central helpers like isInSunlight(Player), isNight(Player), and isUndead(Player) live in shared utility classes for maximum reuse.

Class Descriptions
Undead
A cursed warrior caught between life and death.

Sunlight Vulnerability By checking world time, weather, sky light level, and roof exposure, exposed Undead players catch fire via player.setFireTicks() alongside flame sounds and ash particles.

Water Weakness Entering any Material.WATER or BUBBLE_COLUMN deals periodic damage, spawns smoke particles, and sends a chilling message.

Vampiric Strikes On hitting living entities (via EntityDamageByEntityEvent), Undead soak life back—more health at night—with a per-player cooldown, heart particles, and spectral sounds.

Night Speed While the sun sleeps, Undead gain a permanent speed buff to hunt in the graveyard.

Kiborg
A high-tech soldier of tomorrow fitted with built-in weaponry.

Fireball Launcher Right-click air or block with an empty hand to fire a customized Fireball. It spawns at eye level, flies at 1.5× speed, has configurable yield, and can be set non-incendiary.

Cooldown & Overheat A 60-second cooldown simulates weapon overheat, disabling fire if still active.

Underwater Lockout Submerge and the Kiborg’s systems disable, warning the player that firing is offline.

Tactical Feedback Ghast-shoot sounds, optional smoke rings on charge, and console messages maintain immersion.

Automaton
A half-mechanical humanoid powered by internal energy cores.

Self-Destruct At low energy or via command, triggers an AOE explosion that damages nearby entities.

Terrain Debuffs Standing on metal slows the Automaton, while lava contact inflicts heat damage.

Energy Feeds Special “power cells” or electric pressure plates refill hunger/energy, enabling extended uptime.

Passive Armor Enhanced physical resistance but critical vulnerability to electrical shocks.

Ambient FX Crackling electric arcs, metallic clanks, and motor hums follow your every move.

Richman
An aristocrat whose wealth is both boon and burden.

Greed Metric Inventory value and held currency sum up to a “greed” score, recalculated every few seconds.

Wealth Buffs Crossing wealth thresholds grants mining speed boosts, saturation buffs, and bonus damage vs. mobs.

Richness Debuffs Hoard too much, and you suffer slowness and accelerated hunger to balance the scales.

Dynamic Feedback Gold-colored particles swirl when buffs activate; chat messages notify you of your rising or falling fortune.

Extensibility & Next Steps
Configurable Balancing via config.yml for cooldown durations, damage values, and particle counts.

New Classes can be added by registering a new key in playerClasses, hooking events, and defining custom checks with shared utilities.

Localization & Commands such as /class me, /class switch <name>, and per-class help in multiple languages.

Performance & Cleanup: automatically clear maps on player logout, migrate deprecated health APIs to modern Attributes, and benchmark heavy listeners.

With PowerPlugin, your server becomes an immersive RPG playground where environment, class synergy, and strategic cooldowns define epic battles and unforgettable adventures.

- 🌌 Atmospheric effects:
- Whispers, strange sounds, illusory shadows and lightning.

- 💻 Command `/test me` - will show the player's state: HP, saturation, class, greed level, etc.

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download `MyPlugin.jar`.
2. Place it in the `plugins` folder on the Paper or Spigot server.
3. Restart the server.
4. Configure the plugin via commands or config (if required).

## ⚙️ Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20+ (or any compatible version with API changes)
- Java 17+
- PaperMC or compatible Spigot server

text
/test me

title: AutoTillDirt
description: A simple client-side mod that can automatically till dirt for you.
body:
**A simple client-side mod that will automatically till dirt and grass blocks for you when it is enabled and you are holding a hoe. Below is a list of commands you can use to customize what it does.**

---

### Commands

### `/autoTill enable`
Enables AutoTill. AutoTill will automatically till blocks when you are holding a hoe and it is enabled.

### `/autoTill disable`
Disables AutoTill. AutoTill will not till blocks while disabled.

### `/autoTill radius <float>`
Sets how far around the player AutoTill should scan for dirt and grass blocks.

### `/autoTill onlyBelowFeet <true|false>`
If true, only tills blocks in a circular radius below the players feet. If false, will till every block in a spherical radius around the player.

### `/autoTill allowBreakTools <true|false>`
If false, AutoTill will not break hoes, and stop tilling when the hoe reaches 1 durability. 

### `/autoTill maxBlocksPerTick <int>`
Sets the maximum number of blocks AutoTill will attempt to till in a single tick.

### `/autoTill sort <closest|furthest|random>`
Changes which blocks to prioritize.

### `/autoTill help <closest|furthest|random>`
Sends this list of commands in chat.

title: HeartBite
description: allows players to modify their maximum health using custom golden apples and a reset command
body:
![Heartbitelogo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/467ee0537e6c2d57ea28672d649690a620cd4fc5.png)

---

Introduces two powerful and dangerous golden apple variants along with a utility command to reset player health. Designed for exploration rewards, server events, or admin tools, it provides a meaningful way to enhance your server's gameplay loop and challenge your players.

---

**Features**

*The Vital Apple*
* Permanent Health Boost - A rare and valuable item that permanently increases a player’s maximum health.
* Exploration Reward - Features a 10% chance to appear in naturally generated loot chests, granting a randomized boost of +1 to +3 hearts.
* Admin Command - Server operators can grant this item directly using `/giveauricapple <player> <hearts>`.

*The Cursed Death Apple*
* Permanent Health Reduction - A dangerous item that permanently reduces a player’s max health (down to a minimum of 1 heart).
* Punishing Effects - Inflicts instant damage, along with Blindness and Nausea for 3 seconds. It actively overrides typical golden apple effects like Regeneration and Absorption.
* OP Command Only - Perfect for hardcore challenges or risky PvP events. Obtainable only via the `/givecursedapple <player> <hearts>` command.

*Admin Tools*
* Health Reset - Safely restore a player’s max health back to the default 10 hearts (20 HP). Great for undoing changes or rebalancing gameplay after an event.
* Command - Use `/resethearts <player>` (OP only) to trigger the reset.

title: Recov
description: A lightweight server-side plugin that stores player inventories on death, so that they can be restored if needed.
body:
This fabric mod is meant to be installed on the server only. It will detect player deaths and cache their inventories for some period of time. During this period, a server administrator can easily restore the items to the player.

The plugin is interacted with entirely through a command API. The actions are all subcommands of the `recov` command.

The commands are listed below.
```
/recov list [<player>]
/recov list [<onlyOnlinePlayers>] [<filter>]
/recov clear [<player>]
/recov restore <player> [<deathNumber>] [<sourcePlayer>]
/recov printDeathInventory <player> [<deathNumber>]
/recov setTicksUntilExpired <ticksUntilExpired>
/recov setTickUpdatePeriod <tickUpdatePeriod>
/recov setMaxInventoriesPerPlayer <maxInventoriesPerPlayer>
/recov setRequirePermissionToCache <requirePermissionToCache>
```

The `list` command, with no arguments passed, will list players who have stored inventories, including offline players. When passing a player's username, it will list the death inventories of that player.
The second set of optional arguments for the `list` command will allow one to only view the inventories of online players, and specify an optional filter.
A consequence of this is that, if one wants to list the death inventories of players whose names are either `true` or `false`, one must specify them in all uppercase. So,
`/recov list TRUE` will list the inventories of the player whose username is `true`, which `/recov list true` will list the players who are online and who have death inventories.

The `clear` command, with zero parameters,
will clear all death inventories. When passing a player's username, it will only clear that player's death inventories.

The `restore` command will restore a player's inventory. The `deathNumber` field specifies which death to restore from. If you want to restore the death inventory of one player to a different one, you can use the `sourcePlayer` parameter.

The `printDeathInventory` command will print the items in a player's inventory at the time of their death.

The `setTicksUntilExpired` will set the amount of ticks the mod will wait before deleting a player death inventory entry.
By default, this is set to `48000`.

The `setTickUpdatePeriod` will set the amount of time the mod will wait before checking if there are any expired death inventories to remove.
By default, this is set to `8000`.

The `setMaxInventoriesPerPlayer` will set the maximum inventories per player. If any more deaths occur, the oldest inventories are deleted early.
By default, this is set to `10`.

The `setRequirePermissionToCache` will set whether the plugin will check if a player has the `recov.cacheinventory` permission before caching their inventory on death.
By default, this is set to `false`.

**!!! DO NOT ENABLE `setRequirePermissionToCache` IF THE SERVER DOES NOT HAVE A PERMISSIONS MOD/PLUGIN. IT WILL CRASH ON ANY PLAYER DEATH !!!**

Players with permission level of at least 3 have access to all `recov` commands, but they do not have the `recov.cacheinventory` permission.
If you are using a permissions mod, the following permissions correspond to
each command.

| Permission                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
|----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `recov.command.recov.list`                   | Required to use the `list` subcommand.                                                                                                                                          |
| `recov.command.recov.clear`                  | Required to use the `clear` subcommand.                                                                                                                                         |
| `recov.command.recov.restore`                | Required to use the `restore` subcommand.                                                                                                                                       |
| `recov.command.recov.printDeathInventory`    | Required to use the `printDeathInventory` subcommand.                                                                                                                           |
| `recov.command.recov.configure`              | Required to use any of the configuration subcommands, which are `setTicksUntilExpired`, `setTickUpdatePeriod`, `setMaxInventoriesPerPlayer`, and `setRequirePermissionToCache`. |
| `recov.cacheinventory`                       | Required to have inventory cached if `requirePermissionToCache` is set to `true`.                                                                                               |

Removing the `recov.cacheinventory` permission from a player will not clear their currently-existing cached inventories.

A new set made with mud bricks, to have more variated textures while using only dirt, and another way to obtain mud blocks easier.

# Why mud?
I don't know, I like the texture and color palette from the mud bricks, is cheap because it is made of just dirt, wheat and water.

In my case, I built an entire city and castle using ONLY mud bricks in survival, it wasn't difficult and it was pretty cool, but very annoying using a mud farm to obtain all that amount of blocks, and I would like more variety of textures while still using the same material.

# How can I obtain the new blocks?
You can use the stone cutter to obtain the new blocks, and using the stone cutter again or the crafting table to craft doors, trapdoors, stairs, slabs, fences and fence gates, and the sapling.

# Is there any way to obtain mud easier and faster without any farms?
****YES!**** right click when having a water bucket in off-hand and dirt in main-hand. Does not consume the water from the bucket, to make it easier to get mud from dirt when you can't (or don't want to) go to a mangrove swamp.

# I cannot break mud planks/logs with the axe!
All blocks from this mod are (obviously) made of ****mud bricks****, thy are ****NOT**** wood or real leaves, so you can't craft sticks or wooden related items, even if it looks like planks or logs, still need a pickaxe to obtain the blocks, leaves doesn't despawn if you break the log, mud sapling doesn't grow (should it grow?).

This has been made with MCreator. I'm not proud about this, but until I learn how to program in Java for Minecraft, I have to use this.

title: ⭐ Ultra ItemLock
description: A plugin that allows players to lock a slot in their inventory so that they cannot drop or move the item.
body:
![Plugin logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/200469c27a4428fddcd2727412f001cf77e9b699.png)

---

## 👀 Overview

Take control of your Minecraft inventory like never before with **UltraItemLock**! Whether you're running a survival server or a skyblock server, this plugin is the perfect tool to protect valuable items and prevent unwanted actions.

## ✨ Key Features

- **🔐 Item Locking & Unlocking**
  Players can lock items with a simple command, preventing them from being dropped, moved, or placed until unlocked.
  
- **🎨 Customizable Messages**
  Fully configurable messages to match your server’s style. Supports 🎨 Classic Minecraft color codes!
  
- **📜 Lore-Based Locking**
 Use customizable lore text to lock and identify items easily.
 
- **❌ Event Prevention**
  Stop locked items from being:

   ‣ ⬇️ Dropped
  
   ‣ 🔄 Moved in inventories
  
   ‣ 🧱 Placed as blocks

## 🛠️ Config Auto-Update
Automatically updates your config.yml with new features while preserving your custom settings.

## 🛡️ Commands & Permissions
- **/lock** – Locks the item in the player’s hand. _(Permission: itemlock.lock)_
- **/unlock** – Unlocks the item in the player’s hand. _(Permission: itemlock.unlock)_

title: Infini TNT
description: TNT everywhere and forever.
body:
# Infini TNT

## Project Overview:
The **Infini TNT Datapack** is a fun and chaotic Minecraft addon that allows TNT explosions to continue indefinitely. Once you ignite TNT, the explosion will trigger an exponential chain of additional TNT explosions. Each subsequent explosion spawns more TNT at the same location, causing an ever-growing series of explosions. This leads to a fun, if destructive, experience.

This datapack is intended for players looking to add an extreme challenge or experiment with TNT in a whole new way. It is designed to create a unique, fast-paced environment full of chaos and unpredictability.

## Features:
- **Exponential Explosion Growth**: Each TNT explosion spawns two new TNT entities with normal fuse times, creating a chain reaction that continues indefinitely.
- **Normal Fuse**: Each new TNT spawned has a standard 4-second fuse, ensuring it behaves like a normal TNT explosion.
- **Fully Automatic**: Once the datapack is loaded, the TNT explosions will keep going until manually stopped, with no further interaction needed.
- **World-Altering Fun**: Watch as your Minecraft world is torn apart by continuous TNT explosions that double in size as time progresses.

## Warning:
This datapack can quickly cause severe lag or even crash the game due to the exponential increase in TNT explosions. **Use responsibly** and only in a world where you’re prepared for the consequences!

## How It Works:
- The **`load.mcfunction`** file runs on load and provides a warning to all players about the potentially dangerous behavior of the datapack, along with a clickable command to stop the explosions if necessary.
- The **`tick.mcfunction`** file runs every game tick, checking for TNT explosions that are about to occur and triggering the spawning of new TNT entities.
- The **`double.mcfunction`** file spawns new TNT entities at calculated positions after each explosion, ensuring that the chain continues exponentially.

## Installation:
1. Download the datapack.
2. Place it in the `datapacks` folder of your Minecraft world.
3. Type `/reload` in-game to load the datapack.
4. Ignite a TNT block to start the explosive chain reaction.

## Stop the Chain:
To stop the explosions, simply click the following command in the chat to remove all TNT entities from the world:
**`/kill @e[type=tnt]`**

## Compatibility:
This datapack should be compatible with Minecraft Java Edition 1.20 and higher.

Enjoy the chaos, and may the explosions never end!

title: HauntedSands StationAPI
description: A StationAPI mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 that adds new sand types, graves (death chests), and lost souls.
body:
# Haunted Sands

A StationAPI mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 that adds new sand types, graves, and lost souls.
- Special thanks to DRAGON-STUDIO and HorrorSoundsAsWav over on Pixabay for the mob sounds!
- Credit to K1W1XD and Mimihanne for the skins used to make the lost soul entity.
- Mod works on Multiplayer with [GlassConfigAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/glass-config-api) version 3.0+ used to sync configs!
  - Requires [ZastavkaAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/zastavkaapi) to work on servers, until StationAPI fixes its falling blocks.
- All features can be enabled/disabled through [GlassConfigAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/glass-config-api) as well.

### Terrain Generation Features

* Allows overworld generation of rare pockets of gunpowder in caves
  * Generates between Y levels 4 and 52
  * Generates 0 to 23 gunpowder cubes
  * Does not generate in Forest, Plains, or Tundra biomes
  * Often will catch fire immediately from lava and explode on generation
    * Explosion is not strong enough to break stone
* Allows nether generation of stripes of redstone sand
  * Generates below Y level 80
  * Generates 0 to 63 redstone sand
* Allows nether generation of small flat stars of glowstone sand
  * Generates at all Y levels
  * Generates 0 to 13 glowstone sand

### Sand/Cube Features

* Glowstone Sand
  * Glows like glowstone and falls like sand!
  * When crafting is enabled glowstone sand is made like vanilla glowstone and glowstone is made by smelting the sand
  * Soil Properties:
    * Cactus and Sugar Cane can be planted and grow on it
    * Dead bushes can be planted on it (they will not grow)
* Redstone Sand
  * Emits a redstone signal when it lands
  * Soil Properties:
    * Dead bushes and small plants can be planted on it (they will not grow)
* Sugar Cube
  * Dissolves when it falls into water or lava
  * Saddled pigs can eat the sugar cube by walking on it
  * Soil Properties:
    * Sugar Cane can be planted and grow on it
    * Dead bushes and small plants can be planted on it (they will not grow)
* Gunpowder Cube
  * Explodes when it falls
  * Highly flammable
  * Soil Properties:
    * Cactus can be planted and grow on it
    * Dead bushes can be planted on it (they will not grow)

### Other Features

* Ability to create a lost soul on player death that is wearing the dead player's armor
  * Lost soul is a new flying mob that can no clip through blocks
  * The lost soul attacks by charging the player
    * Charge speed increases as the mob gets closer to their player target
    * Lost souls can charge a second time if they are in a solid opaque block
  * You can trap lost souls in translucent blocks like tree leaves, ice, glass, snow layers, tall grass, etc.
    * If you are having trouble with lost souls the surface is your friend!
  * Lost souls drop stolen armor on death along with a locked chest (used in the Grave crafting recipe)
  * No lost soul will be created if player inventory and armor slots are empty
  * Lost souls also spawn rarely when soul sand is broken
* Ability to create a grave on player death that contains main inventory items (including hotbar)
  * The grave will not contain armor or modded slot items
  * Grave vanishes on use and items are dropped (a permanent version can be crafted, see recipe below)
  * Grave is blast resistant to creepers
    * A creeper standing on it may still be able to blow it up (usually only happens with slab graves)
  * Grave will be a slab if less than half or half the main inventory slots are filled
    * Grave slabs combine using beta slab logic
  * Grave will be a full block (Columbarium) if more than half the main inventory slots are filled
  * No grave will be created if player main inventory is empty
* Pigs will now seek out sugar and brown mushrooms when they are in item form
  * Pigs will eat the sugar healing them 0.5 hearts if they are hurt
  * The pigs are rather finicky and sometimes won't seek out or do anything
    * You can try to push/prod them to get them moving again, but it won't always work
  * Saddled pigs also have a slight pathing preference for sugar cube and brown mushroom blocks (not noticeable in small quantities)
    * Saddled pigs lose their slight pathing preference for grass blocks since they are now seeking the other blocks

### Crafting Recipes

All crafting recipes can be turned on/off from the mod config menu.
* All sands/cubes are crafted by placing 4 of the correct item in a square.
  * If enabled sands/cubes can be de-crafted back into 4 of the item used to make them. (default disabled)
* Graves can be crafted with soul sand, any vanilla slab, and either a regular chest or a locked chest.
  * Locked chests are a vanilla block that is normally unobtainable but will drop when a lost soul mob is killed.

See: https://modrinth.com/project/hauntedsands-stationapi/gallery

## Installation using Prism Launcher

1. Download an instance of Babric for Prism Launcher: https://github.com/Glass-Series/babric-prism-instance
2. Install Java 17 and set the instance to use it: https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/
3. Add GlassConfigAPI 3.0.2+ to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/glass-config-api
4. Add Glass Networking to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/glass-networking
5. Add StationAPI to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/stationapi
6. Add ZastavkaAPI to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/zastavkaapi
7. (Optional) Add Mod Menu to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu-beta
8. Add this mod to the mod folder for the instance: https://github.com/telvarost/HauntedSands-StationAPI/releases
9. Run and enjoy! 👍

## Feedback

Got any suggestions on what should be added next? Feel free to share it by [creating an issue](https://github.com/telvarost/HauntedSands-StationAPI/issues/new). Know how to code and want to do it yourself? Then look below on how to get started.

## Contributing

Thanks for considering contributing! To get started fork this repository, make your changes, and create a PR. 

If you are new to StationAPI consider watching the following videos on Babric/StationAPI Minecraft modding: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9-sVGjnGJ5s&list=PLa2JWzyvH63wGcj5-i0P12VkJG7PDyo9T

# Kid Survival

A Fabric server-side mod for kid-friendly Minecraft servers. Toggle invulnerability for young players with `/kid`, or start a multiplayer Hunter Tag game with `/hunter`.

## Features

### Kid Mode

- `/kid` toggle — grants invulnerability and continuous health restoration
- Available to all players, no operator permissions needed
- State persists across server restarts

### Hunger Mode

- `/hunger` toggle — keeps food and saturation maxed so the player never gets hungry
- Independent of Kid Mode; enable either on its own or both together
- Combined status is shown in the action bar ("Kid Mode + No Hunger", "Kid Mode Active", or "No Hunger")
- Available to all players, no operator permissions needed
- State persists across server restarts

### Hunter Tag

- `/hunter` starts a round — the invoking player becomes the hunter, everyone else becomes a runner
- Hunter is frozen for 30 seconds, then chases runners
- Tag runners by melee attack (no damage dealt, compatible with kid mode)
- Tagged runners become hunters
- When the last runner is tagged, scores are reported and a new round auto-starts
- Colored team names (`[Hunter]`/`[Runner]`) and glowing effect on hunters
- Role shown in action bar with freeze countdown
- Cumulative runner-time scoring across rounds
- Handles disconnects (pause/resume) and mid-game joins
- `/bench` opts a player out entirely — benched players are skipped when rounds start and never auto-join mid-game
- Game state and scores persist across server restarts

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API (matching MC version)
- Java 25
- Server-side only — no client mod needed

## Installation (Prism Launcher)

1. Create or select a Minecraft 26.2 instance in Prism Launcher
2. Click **Edit Instance** > **Version** tab > **Install Fabric** — select loader 0.19.3+
3. Download Fabric API from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (match Minecraft version 26.2)
4. Build or obtain `kidsurvival-2.2.2.jar` (see [Building from Source](#building-from-source))
5. Click **Edit Instance** > **Mods** tab > **Add** — add both the Fabric API and Kid Survival JARs
6. For dedicated servers: place both JARs in the server's `mods/` folder

## Usage

- `/kid` — toggle invulnerability (any player can run it)
- `/hunger` — toggle no-hunger mode, keeping food and saturation full (any player can run it)
- `/hunter` — start a Hunter Tag round (needs 2+ non-benched online players)
- `/bench` — toggle opting out of Hunter Tag (any player can run it)

## Building from Source

```
git clone <repo-url>
cd kidsurvival
./gradlew build
```

Output JAR: `build/libs/kidsurvival-2.2.2.jar`

## Troubleshooting

- **/kid command not found:** Ensure the mod JAR and Fabric API are both in the `mods/` folder and the server has restarted.
- **Kid mode didn't persist after restart:** Check that the server shut down cleanly (not force-killed). State is saved during normal shutdown.
- **Version mismatch errors:** Ensure Fabric API version matches your Minecraft version (26.2).
- **/hunter says need 2+ players:** Hunter Tag requires at least 2 online players to start a round.
- **Hunter Tag game won't start:** The command must be run by a player, not the server console.

## Changelog

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the release history.

title: Stress Ball
description: Adds two auto‑attacking baubles inspired by Terraria.
body:
**Stress Ball - Auto-Attack Baubles**  

This mod adds two new baubles inspired by Terraria: the **Stress Ball** and its upgraded version, the **Pressure Ball**. Both items require the **Baubles** mod as a dependency and are designed for Minecraft 1.12.2.  

## Features  

### Stress Ball  
- Automatically performs a left-click attack every 0.5 seconds when the player stands still and has no GUI open (e.g., inventory, chests, crafting tables).  
- Attack respects the weapon's attack speed: if the weapon's cooldown is longer than 0.5 seconds, attacks occur at the weapon's natural rate; if shorter, a 0.5‑second minimum interval prevents exceeding the invincibility frame limit.  
- Attack range is fixed at 3 blocks (same as default player reach).  
- Configurable item blacklist: if the player holds a blacklisted item in the main hand, no automatic attacks occur.  

### Pressure Ball  
- An upgraded version of the Stress Ball.  
- Also attacks automatically when standing still, but **without any GUI restriction** and includes a brief cooldown after moving.  
- In addition to the standard left-click attack, it can be configured to **trigger right‑click actions** for specific items (e.g., Tinkers' Construct shurikens, TConEvo spectres, PlusTIC laser guns).  
- Features a configurable **entity blacklist** (e.g., item frames, paintings, armor stands) to prevent accidental attacks.  
- Inherits the same attack range, cooldown mechanics, and item blacklist as the Stress Ball.  

## Crafting Recipes  

### Stress Ball  
- **Pattern**:  
  - Iron blocks (I) in the corners  
  - Redstone blocks (R) in cardinal directions  
  - Gold block (G) in the center  
- **Result**: 1 Stress Ball  

### Pressure Ball  
- **Pattern**:  
  - Lapis lazuli blocks (L) in the corners  
  - Diamond blocks (D) in cardinal directions  
  - Stress Ball (S) in the center  
- **Result**: 1 Pressure Ball  

All recipes are shapeless and can be viewed in-game with JEI.  

## Configuration  

A JSON configuration file is generated at `config/stressball.json` after the first run. You can edit it to customize:  

```json
{
  "itemBlacklist": ["cyclicmagic:storage_bag"],
  "entityBlacklist": ["minecraft:item_frame", "minecraft:painting", "minecraft:armor_stand", "minecraft:item"],
  "rightClickItems": ["tconstruct:shuriken", "tconevo:tool_sceptre", "plustic:laser_gun"]
}
```  

- **itemBlacklist**: Items in this list will **not** trigger automatic attacks when held.  
- **entityBlacklist**: Entities in this list will **not** be attacked.  
- **rightClickItems** (Pressure Ball only): When holding any item from this list, the Pressure Ball will trigger its **right‑click** action instead of a left‑click attack.  

## Notes  
- This mod was created with the assistance of AI.  
- Requires Minecraft 1.12.2, Forge, and Baubles.  

## Credits  
Inspired by the Stress Ball item from Terraria.

**License:** MIT. All versions are MIT-licensed. v0.0.3+ includes `LICENSE.txt` inside the JAR.

title: Consumable Berries
description: Allows players to eat Cobblemon berries, with special effects!
body:
Normally, Cobblemon berries can only be consumed by pokémon, as players cannot eat it. However, this addon mod changes that, allowing players to eat them like food. They can also give players special effects, to the benefit or detriment of them.

This mod is still in its beta stages and very few berries have an effect at the moment.

### Customization
There's two main files you can change to customize CB's behavior. The main one is effects.json, which can be changed by datapacks (`data/consumableberries/cb_data/effects.json`), this file determines which effects a berry can or cannot have.

The second file, `config/cm_berries.json`, determines which berries can be eaten, and what their nutrition and saturation values are. It also has the `alwaysEdible` flag, which if toggled allows the player to eat that berry even if their hunger bar is full. If an entry is NOT present in it, the berry cannot be eaten at all, you can use this to disable specific berries.

### Notes
- Consumable Berries disables the party select GUI when right-clicking a berry to avoid a conflict. You can still "pick" a pokémon by right-clicking them in the world.
- Berries cannot be eaten in battle. They'll behave the same as if you didn't have this mod.

title: Weather Extended
description: More weather conditions to Minecraft!
body:
# Vanilla Weather Extended

> Do you think that rain and thunder is annoying? How about we add more weather conditions? 

Weather Extended is an addon for WeatherCore that adds multiple weather conditions to Minecraft.

Requires [WeatherCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/weathercore).

## Why not another mod?

This mod is a specific solution to my problem: Adding new weather conditions in a more vanilla style than the other available weather mods. Adding tornadoes or meteorites are not the scope of my mod (even if it's possible). But blood rain, rainbow rains, different type of fogs, magic particles auras or anything else is what I'm aiming for.

## Features

Currently, Weather Extended adds:
- Fog
- Radioactive Storm (Requires Alexs Caves to be installed)
- Fireworks
- Gray Pall
- Death Pall
- Wind

Those weathers spawn naturally, except Radioactive Storm that needs to be enabled in the configuration. Nucleepers and Nuclear Bombs are able to create long-lasting radioactives storms around the explosion, be careful~!

The Gray Pall is a unique weather condition that creates a brown fog with ashes falling from the sky. Being exposed to the sky will give you a short hunger effect.

description: Every boop becomes Purrgress. Hold to click, rank up to 10 million, and unlock a suspiciously ridiculous parade of pixel cats.
body:
## Purrgress 🐱✨🐾

Every boop becomes **Purrgress**. 🐈💥

Click, hold, rank up, and summon a deeply unnecessary parade of animated pixel cats. Your HUD purrs, sparkles, wiggles, bounces, and changes kitty forms as you climb from humble click gremlin to **Big Bang Button Boss** at **10,000,000 clicks**. 🐾🌌😼

## Features 🐱

- Hold left click to keep gaining clicks 🐾
- Animated pixel cat HUD 😺
- 41 ranks, all the way to 10 million clicks 🌟
- 41 silly kitty names, one for each rank 🐈‍⬛
- Moveable and resizeable HUD 📦
- Paw bursts, purr feedback, sparkles, and dramatic cat energy ✨
- Saves your progress locally 🐟

## Commands 🐾

- `/purrgress reset`  
  Reset your click progress.

- `/purrgress hud move`  
  Open the HUD mover. Use your paws to move it around. Zoom in and out to resize.

- `/purrgress hud <x> <y>`  
  Move the HUD to a specific screen position.

- `/purrgress hud scale <percent>`  
  Resize the HUD from `60` to `300` percent.

- `/purrgress hud reset`  
  Reset the HUD position and scale.

## Requirements 🧶

- Minecraft `1.21.8`
- Fabric Loader `0.18.0+`
- Fabric API
- Java `21`

## Config 🐈

Progress is saved locally in:

`config/purrgress.json`

title: Survival Magnet's
description: Add two new magnets to the game.
body:
# Magnetic Tools Datapack

This datapack is **based on the excellent work** by [webdiamond](https://modrinth.com/user/webdiamond), original [Magnet](https://modrinth.com/datapack/magnet_magnet) datapack.  
I'm very thankful for their inspiration — and if you're looking for a **simpler version with easier crafting**, I definitely recommend checking it out!

---

This version introduces **two custom magnetic tools** designed for more balanced, survival-friendly gameplay.  
They help you easily gather nearby dropped items with just a simple offhanding.

## Features

- **Basic Magnet**  
  Pulls all nearby dropped items within a **6-block radius** (12×12 area).  
  Simple and useful for quick cleanups while mining or farming.

- **Advanced Magnet**  
  An upgraded version with an impressive **32-block radius** (64×64 area).  
  Perfect for farms or large-scale collection.

Both magnets are crafted with valuable materials to reflect their usefulness and power. Crafting recipes are included in the datapack and designed to maintain balance.

## Screenshots

Magnets use lantern models to blend naturally with the vanilla aesthetic. If you use a **3D lantern resource pack**, the visual effect is even better! *(See screenshots in the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/datapack/survival-magnets/gallery).)*

## Future Plans

- **Custom resource pack**: I'm working on unique models for the magnets, but they already look great as lanterns for now.
- **Balancing improvements**: I want to add conditions or limitations to magnets, such as:
  - Durability or cooldowns  
  - Custom attributes  
  - Potential drawbacks or side effects

---

Let me know what you think, and feel free to suggest ideas!  
Hope you enjoy using magnets as much as I enjoyed creating them.

title: EduGuard
description: A Minecraft Java PaperMC server plugin for managing and automating classroom servers.
body: # EduGuard EduGuard is a PaperMC plugin for Minecraft Java Edition designed to manage class schedules and automate various in-game actions based on those schedules. It provides features such as automatic kicking of players, enabling/disabling the whitelist, and resetting the in-game day time based on predefined end-of-class times. --- ## Features - **Automatic Kicking**: Automatically kicks players at the end of class. - **Whitelist Management**: Enables and disables the whitelist around class end times to prevent rejoins. - **Day Time Reset**: Resets the in-game day time based on class schedules so each session has a similar experience. - **Profanity Filter**: Built in profanity filtering for chat messages and usernames. - **Configurable Settings**: All features are highly configurable through a YAML configuration file. --- ## Installation 1. Download the latest release of EduGuard from either [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/edu-guard/versions), [Hangar](https://hangar.papermc.io/megabyte6/EduGuard/versions), or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/megabyte6/EduGuard/releases/latest). 2. Place the `.jar` file in your Minecraft server's `plugins/` directory. 3. Start your server to generate the default configuration files. 4. Configure the plugin by editing the `config.yml` file located in the `plugins/EduGuard/` directory. --- ## Configuration The main configuration file is `config.yml`. Here you can enable or disable features and set various parameters such as class end times, auto-kick settings, whitelist settings, and reset day settings. ### Example Configuration Configuration uses [YAML](https://yaml.org/). ```yaml auto-kick: enabled: true message: Server is now closed. Time to exit the Dojo! before-end-of-class: 60 # seconds show-warning: true enable-whitelist-on-kick: true disable-whitelist-after: 360 # seconds (six minutes) reset-day: enabled: true before-end-of-class: 600 # seconds (ten minutes) minecraft-world-name: "world" minecraft-time: 6000 # ticks (Minecraft world time) use-absolute-time: false end-of-class-times: monday: - "15:00" - "17:00" tuesday: - "15:00" - "17:00" # Add more days and times as needed profanity-filter: filter-chat: true filter-usernames: true prohibited-words: - prohibited word 1 - prohibited word 2 # Add more words as needed ``` --- ## FAQ ### What about Minecraft version...? You can find a release for the latest version of Minecraft on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/edu-guard/versions), [Hangar](https://hangar.papermc.io/megabyte6/EduGuard/versions), or under [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/megabyte6/EduGuard/releases/latest). Support for older version can be made available upon request. If there is a version of Minecraft you wish to see supported, [submit an issue](https://github.com/megabyte6/EduGuard/issues/new). ### What happened to versions 1.0.0 to 3.1.0? v1.0.0 through to v3.1.0 all used an old config system that was messy and difficult to maintain. In v4.0.0, I renamed the project and felt it was a good time to implement some breaking changes I've been wanting to bring about for a while now. Unfortunately, while these changes make future edits much easier, upgrading from older configs is quite difficult. As such, to reduce the amount of legacy code in the codebase, I have dropped support for versions v1.0.0 to v3.1.0. Please do __not__ use those versions. All features from those versions are present in v4.0.0 and should exist, one way or another, in all future versions so there really is no reason to use bother with those legacy versions. --- ## License This project is licensed under [GPLv3](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html).

title: Spinning Tomahawk
description: Adds throwable spinning tomahawks that return to your hand, chop trees and vegetation in their path, and come in elemental variants with unique combat powers.
body:
▌ Spinning Tomahawk adds throwable axes that function as both reliable melee tools and deadly ranged weapons. Throw your tomahawk and watch it spin through the air, cutting down grass, crops, and entire trees in its path before faithfully returning to your hand. If it hits an enemy, it bounces back immediately; if it reaches its maximum range, it curves around and flies back to you.
![display](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07fabaf9c740b010964718781ca7334c77d296c5_0.webp)
![dual holding](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/476375925d0f88370f878db69886f332a3dc6598_0.webp)
  ▌ The mod launches with three unique tomahawk variants, each with a distinct combat style:
 
**Spinning Tomahawk** — The classic balanced thrower. Cuts vegetation and fells entire trees along its flight path. Can be dual-wielded for rapid throws.

**Ender Spinning Tomahawk** — After throwing, right-click while the axe is still flying to instantly teleport to its location and recall it. Perfect for crossing gaps, reaching high places, or making a swift escape.

**Berserker Spinning Tomahawk** — A brutal weapon with a 40% chance to deal massive bonus damage on impact. Heals your health and restores hunger and saturation with every successful hit, turning you into an unstoppable force.

**Blast Spinning Tomahawk** — Crafted with TNT, this axe detonates on impact with any block or entity, dealing explosive damage to everything nearby. Use wisely in close combat to avoid catching yourself in the blast.

**Frost Spinning Tomahawk** — Infused with chilling frost energy, it inflicts Slowness and Weakness on every target it hits, leaving them helpless. Excellent for controlling powerful enemies or creating openings for your allies.

**Magnetic Spinning Tomahawk** — Built around a magnetic core, it pulls in nearby dropped items and experience orbs as it flies, delivering them straight back to your inventory. An indispensable tool for exploration and looting.

**Ultimate Spinning Tomahawk** — A legendary weapon that pierces through both entities and blocks, branding every struck foe with a devastating mark. Upon returning to your hand, all marks detonate simultaneously, unleashing massive true damage.

  ▌ All tomahawks retain full axe functionality — they can strip logs, scrape oxidation off copper, remove wax, and efficiently harvest any block mineable with an axe. They can also be fired from Dispensers and will return automatically. Supports JEI and is fully localized in 8 languages.
  
  ▌ More elemental variants are planned for future updates!

title: Entity Observer
description: This project adds two new blocks. The Entity observer and the Player observer. The Entity observer gives a redstone signal if a entity is in front of it. The Player observer is the same, but for players.
body:
## Entity Observer

**The Entity Observer mod** is a mod that adds two blocks. The **Entity Observer** and the **Player Observer.**

### Functionality

The functionality of these two blocks is **very simple**. If the target _identity_ stands in front of the observer block, the observer block will output a **signal**, and the strength is dependant of how far away the _identity_ is. For example, if a entity is standing **6 blocks** away, the Entity Observer block will _output_ a **signal strength of 9.** That is because the **further** you are from the sensor, the **weaker** the _output will be._

### Naming

The _naming_ of the observers is also **very simple**. The **Entity Observer** will detect _entities_ and _players_ and the **Player Observer** will **_only_** detect _players_.

### Usecases

This makes the blocks _useful_ for
- traps 
- doors
- farms
- alarms
- hidden entrances
- minigames
- other redstone contraptions.

title: Spring's Eco Mod
description: This mod adds more biomes and overall content to Minecraft
body:
![Title Text reading Spring's Eco Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c187b08860d0edaa39b77637139b26cbec09c65.png)

Spring's Eco Mod aims to add more vanilla feeling biomes, geodes, dungeons, and progression changes(however it does break free from the vanilla+ ties the deeper you dive). With 9+* Brand new biomes most of which having unique trees with new wood sets your plate should hopefully be filled.

*some biomes are incomeplete but still accessable with single biome world generation



<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/UUlgnIp1ZHc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


                                     **New Biomes**


The Temperate Forest
![an overhead view of a calm forest with bright green grass and yellow and red trees](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f170a02f09ce55edc9be093df7efc1e27854c35_0.webp)
The temperate forest is a calm biome with not much going on, the biome is loosely based on parts of europe. In this biome you will find the new Tilia trees, if you wait around long enough limes might even grow on the leaves for you to shear off.



The Rainforest
![an overhead view of a chaotic messy dense forest with heavy foliage and tall trees](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28b5d1f5911dc747a2b6c4db837e86c86b4ee834_0.webp)

The rainforest is a very messy biome filled with untamed foliage and aggressive wildlife. In this biome you will find 2 new trees, the Eucalyptus Tree and Tangarana Tree. The Tangarana tree houses very aggressive fire ants that will go after other plants to improve the survivability of their Tangarana Tree nest.



The Grotto Grove

![a dense oak forest with vines](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d59de8326d3c2d7084e54062a6d60bb3cbcf916_0.webp)

The Grotto Grove is one of my personal favorites, its a very dense and calm forest with lots of foliage.



The Dense Birch Forest
![a dense birch forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f2f8ea99782366142732b6612781635df26137e_0.webp)

The Dense Birch Forest is a simple biome, it takes the idea of the old growth birch forest and packs in a little more birch.



The Redwood Forest
![Taiga like forest with large thick trees that tower over everything](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6cc4ae286d9392b16fc67e26d57e195ca65e28e_0.webp)
The Redwood Forest is a forest made up of a towering new tree, The Redwood Tree. You may find some abandoned huts carved out of them.



The Fungal Fields
![swamp like biome with a variety of glowing mushrooms](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f3fd35c170d097dbb56a08408520a8d12aed38d_0.webp)
The Fungal Fields is a swamp like biome filled with colorful glowing mushrooms with unique abilities. This biome brings two new trees, The Cotton Tree and the Ancient Shrooms.



The Fungal Caverns
![a dark cave with large mushrooms and fungal like vines](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/529ddff9b818d8c65501d7d5a043614a889efd0e_0.webp)

The Fungal Caverns are very lifeless fungus dominated caves. The walls are made of shroomstone and the floor is covered in minecelium. The vines can be grown and smelted into a very powerful food source.



The Mahogany Rainforest
![a less dense rainforest with branchy trees](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/257dd2d2120d7f09119406f8e47988dfc6fe319c_0.webp)
The Mahogany Rainforest is a much calmer rainforest with more sparse trees. This biome brings one new tree, the Mahogany Tree.



The End Woodlands
![a wasteland of a forest with round trees and purple moss growing over the endstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3aeac9ead0e284b9b96671903fb86a8903a4e541_0.webp)

The End Woodlands is rather empty, just like the rest of the end. This biome brings one new tree, The Entropic Tree.



                                  **New Structures**

This mod has some cool new structures and dungeons to go with its assortment of biomes.


The Catacombs
![a monument like building buried in the rainforest foliage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d1ca38a77ebcb39402c2c9266cfe178bd53f2e8_0.webp)

The Catacombs are built up of sprawling networks of tunnels and rooms filled with ghouls and spiders, venture deep enough in and you will find a new mini-boss.



The Radio Tower
![a stone brick building with a giant antenna on top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dda267b8e5ff947a50adf1e5ce3f916970f02186_0.webp)
The Radio Tower is like a bunker. Under the main building you will find tunnels that may also be spider infested. If you're lucky you might just stumble across more spiders.



The Fungite Dungeon
![a library with walls made of a light blue stone brick](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5bb94f02982a01cf1aacf91d111a6382dddbb0e4_0.webp)
The Fungite Dungeon is buried deep below the Fungal Fields. It's filled with gemstones and other treasures of the deceased that roam its halls.




                                   **New Minerals**


I wont include geodes here as I already fear this is getting rather long and there is still plenty more to go, so heres all of the minerals that you can forge items from.


Crimsonium
![Bright reddish pink tools are on the wall in item frames.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bac839258bae30f48b438cecfbc46d6fa03308c8.png)
Crimsonium is scattered through out the Nether. It can be forged into tools that have unique health siphoning abilities or be used to upgrade apples just the same as gold. You can also craft the Crimsonium Box which is a new inventory management tool with 9 extra slots +1 specific slot for tools.

(note the sword doesnt do that, this mod works with BetterCombat)



Covellite
![there are bluish purple tools on the wall and an armor set on display made of the same material](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44ae2eeaa4e6409d7dc2b8aa973f2442f20bedfa.png)
Covellite is a step between iron and diamond. It can be forged into a shield, tools, or armor but it can also be used to upgrade beetroots. It is found near lava in the basalt deltas.



Endersteel
![purple crystals and ingots are on the wall in item frames, a model holds a sword and large round shield made of the same stuff.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9a5cdebdf7af69d0130b0cfae7ed64ab0f5d3a3.png)
Endersteel is a crystal like formation found all over the end. It can be used to upgrade Covellite equipment* into Endersteel equipment. Endersteel is all about movement and each endersteel item has a unique ability.
*Only the sword, shield, and boots can be upgraded.




Titanium
![tattered scraps and titanium items are on the wall in item frames, there is a model with a shield and hammer in the center.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0f0d955ec1ffb50282278094d0b6ada4c15736c.png)
Titanium is a rare strong metal, you wont find it anywhere in the ground as it had been harvested long before your time. You can find it scattered across Radio Towers in the overworld. Tattered Metal Scraps need to have the rust blasted off of them before you can use them for crafting. You can use Titanium to forge the Striker, 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The Bone Dagger, and The Vain Shield

</details>




                                   **New Dimension**
                                   



Vain

![limestone islands covered in moss float above a bottomless pool of water. large spires are scattered across the islands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f618f0fe9bb4ca0a36bcffa6834f6b4c651ad3db_0.webp)

Vain is an alien world and is loosely inspired by half-life and Lethal Company. Vain has its own structures and micro-biomes though it is mostly barren. If you wish to visit vain you wont be able to just build a portal. The portals can be found rarely in Radio Towers or if enabled The Gemstone Stronghold. If you want to build your own portal you will need to find the resources for it in Vain.



                                  **Fun & Games**
There are 2 gamerules you can enable to change the way the game plays, being howlerHour and luckyBlockMode. howlerHour will make very agressive Howlers spawn at night all over the overworld. luckyBlockMode will make killing mobs drop lucky blocks(the more health the higher chance for more blocks), I am not responsible for any destruction the blocks may bring unless its really funny.


                                 **Warnings and such**

this mod may be buggy, I am no professional. I will try to fix all the bugs that do pop up. Vain can be laggy for servers to generate. If the game isnt loading the world on creation properly go to the gamerule tab and change generateGemstoneStronghold to false.

title: [Origin] Lapidion
description: Adds the Lapidion Origin, inspired by the Weeping Angels from Doctor Who
body:
# General Information
This datapack adds the Lapidion Origin (derived from the Latin word for stone 'lapis') inspired by the Weeping Angels from Doctor Who.             
The Origin requires **Origins** and **Pehkui**.                                     
**Note that this datapack is intended for multiplayer but may cause lag!**                                                        

## Lapidion 🟡🟡
As descendants of the Lonely Assassins that lived long ago, Lapidions still possess the same defensive mechanism.

🟡**Petrification**                                                                              
While being directly observed, you turn into stone.                                           
You can toggle this state on at will.                                                              
[_While petrified you are unable to move, attack, take damage and interact with blocks or entities_]

🟢**Unimportant**                                                                                  
While petrified, mobs will quickly lose interest in you.                                          
Furthermore, other players cannot properly identify you in your petrified state.                   
[_Your nametag will not be visible while petrified_]

🟢**Swift**                                                                                        
You move significantly faster than others while not exposed to the sun.

🟢**Lonely Assassin**                                                                            
You deal increased damage while not exposed to the sun.                                                    
Additionally, you deal more damage if your target is blinded.                                              

🔵**Space Distortion [Load Hotbar Activator]**                                                     
Anything that you attack has a chance to be randomly teleported.                                            
This can be toggled, but it only works while you are close to the target.                   

🔵**Blink [Primary Ability]**                                                                     
You can instantly teleport to the location you are looking at.                                                     
Doing so while petrified will damage you.                                                      
_Teleporting directly to an entity will either blind it or teleport it if Space Distortion is enabled_   

🔴**Unwieldy**                                                                                    
Thanks to your supernatural defense mechanisms, you never had to learn how to use a shield or wear armor.                                                                                           
While you can still wear armor, it will grant you significantly less protection.

🔴**Sun Aversion**                                                                               
Being exposed to the sun will weaken you and make you slower.

🔵**Watcher's Mark**                                                                                
Entities that directly look at a Lapidion will glow for you even up to five seconds after looking away from one.

title: Rush
description: "It's not so much I like to go win, but it's a rush. A horrible gut wrenching thing, but it's exciting."
body:
**Rush:** A mod aimed at improving upon the game's tool and "ability" progression by introducing cool and reasonably balanced trinkets and items.

### --All Items the Mod Adds--

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**-Leaf Charm:**
An early game item that allows the player to launch themselves up a few blocks. If timed right, it can even negate fall damage!

**-Soul Diffuser:**
An item that makes the player invisible, gives them a lot of resistance and lets them move really fast for a short blink. It's designed to be used without armor on -so the invisibility isn't useless-, but it can also be used with armor.

**-Flash Shard:**
A late game item that instantly blinks the player about 15 blocks in the direction they are facing. This can get you stuck inside solid blocks though, so use it with caution!

**-Bedrock Splitter:**
A late game item that allows you to break one block instantly, giving you the item you broke. As the name suggests, this even works on bedrock!

**-Unbreaking Charm:**
A late game item that lets you make one item of your choice unbreakable. It can only be crafted using bedrock though, so you'll need to have obtained a bedrock splitter before an ubreaking charm.

**-Gem of Repairing:**
A mid game item that can be used to repair your tools without any penalties on the tool.

**-Fight Picker:**
Originally a seperate mod, this battle pickaxe will let you fling your enemies -and yourself- across the battlefield. If not clear enough already, it can also be used as a pickaxe!

</details>

The mod also has some experimental items in it that you can only get via commands, but they are VERY incomplete, so they should be avoided during casual gameplay. A better description for this mod can be found at [the CurseForge page of Rush](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/rush). This description will also be updated with new updates moving forward.

title: Shield Rework
description: Shields now have health and can be broken by any item.
body:
![Shield Rework Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37b5044b9e2e9cf93252060b1299fb444032f5be_0.webp)

# 🤔 What is Shield Rework? Shield Rework changes how shields behave in Minecraft. Shields now have a health bar replacing the durability bar of the item. Hitting a shield will damage its health, and break the shield when it reaches 0. ### Set the gamerule `shield_damage_axe_only` to `true` to make only axes able to damage shields. # 💡 Features - Shields now have 80 hp. - Hitting it will deal damage the same way it would to any entity. - Certain items (axes only by default) deal more damage. - Its health is indicated by how "shattered" its texture looks. - Breaking a shield puts it on a 5s cooldown. - Its health can only be regenerated once the cooldown is elapsed. # 🛠️ Developers - Items doing more damage to shields are contained in the tag `extra_shield_damage`. - By default, it only contains the tag `minecraft:axes`. - Items in this tag deal `4.5` times more damage to shields. - The sources will always be contained alongside the mod's `jar`. # ❓ Q&A
Can I use this in my modpack? Yes.
I have an issue. Where can I report it? Issues can be reported in the help channel of the Discord.
Can you port this to Forge/Neoforge/Quilt? No. I only make mods for Fabric and won't port them for other mod loaders. If you want to make a branch of Legion for another loader, join the Discord and ask for the permission in the **Help** channel. It will almost always be given, but please ask first.
Can you backport the mod to version `x.xx`? No. I make mods for the latest version of the game and will not backport them. Similarly to Question 1, if you want to make a branch of Shield Rework for another version of the game, join the Discord and ask for the permission in the **Help** channel. It will almost always be given, but please ask first.

## Game Modes (Includes but not limited to):

- **Normal**: The classic experience where you simply spawn on a plate and events happen around you. It’s straightforward and perfect for those who enjoy the core unpredictability and challenge of Labs without any added twists.

- **Lucky Blocks**: Start with a block and break it to reveal a random surprise. It could be a helpful item, a tricky trap, or something completely unexpected. The element of chance makes every round in this mode thrilling and unpredictable.

- **Scrambled**: In this mode, you spawn on a plate at a random height, adding an extra layer of challenge and excitement. Adapt quickly to your new surroundings and strategize to survive and thrive from any elevation.

- **Quick Draw**: For those who love fast-paced action, this mode accelerates the pace of events. Experience the intensity of rapid-fire challenges that will test your reflexes and decision-making skills in a high-speed environment.

- **Build Off**: Spawn with 32 blocks and unleash your creativity. Whether building for defense, strategy, or sheer artistic expression, this mode encourages players to think on their feet and use their resources wisely.

- **One Plate**: Everyone spawns on one large plate, creating a communal and intense experience. Work together or compete for resources as random events unfold around you.

- **Shrunk**: Start on a smaller platform than usual, adding an extra layer of difficulty and requiring even more precise strategy and quick thinking to survive.

- **Arbitrary Items**: Receive random blocks every 10~ seconds, adding an unpredictable twist to your strategy and gameplay. Use these items creatively to overcome challenges and outlast your opponents.

## Features:

**Voting System**: One of the unique features of Labs is the ability for players to vote for the mode they want to play. This ensures that everyone has a say in the game, making each session more engaging and democratic. Players can easily cast their votes, adding an extra layer of community involvement and excitement to the server.

**Continuous Updates**: The server is continually updated with new content, ensuring that there's always something fresh and engaging for players. The developers are committed to enhancing the gameplay experience, adding new events, features, and improvements based on player feedback and innovative ideas.

Labs is not just about surviving the random events; it's also about thriving in a dynamic and ever-changing environment. Team up with friends or go solo, explore different strategies, and discover the best ways to navigate the challenges thrown your way. The community is vibrant and welcoming, making Labs a great place to meet new friends and share your gaming adventures.

Join Labs today and dive into a world where every plate holds a new possibility, and every moment is filled with fun and excitement. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the scene, Labs offers an engaging and constantly evolving experience that will keep you coming back for more.

title: CartLoader
description: Enable Minecarts to dynamically load chunks, ensuring seamless long-distance travel without players
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a46e8f7aa5a4fe1095a5ed1b1a9ca786085b2b62.png)

## Keep your Minecarts rolling!

This small plugin loads chunks for moving minecarts automatically, enabling efficient long-distance transport with *no players* and *no manual chunk loaders* required.

Perfect for e.g. automatically sending items in chest minecarts over long distances … and even through portals and the nether!

**Version 3.0.0+ requires the [NBT-API](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nbtapi) plugin as a dependency!**

It works by dynamically loading a region of chunks around moving minecarts only. After the minecart stopped or was destroyed, you can optionally keep the last region loaded for a period of time (e.g. for automatic unloading or other redstone circuits at the destination).  
If there are loaded regions when the server gets stopped, they will be seamlessly loaded again upon the next server start to ensure that the minecarts start moving again.

To offer more flexibility and restrict which players can access these features, the plugin also offers custom "Chunk Loading" minecart items and entities (which always load chunks, regardless of the settings for vanilla minecarts) and can be obtained through the `/cartloader give` OP command and optionally crafted (with customizable shapeless recipe).

### Highly configurable:

* Which types of moving minecarts should load chunks: normal, chest, hopper etc. and this plugin's custom minecarts
* Crafting recipe for the custom minecarts
* The size of the region of chunks around the minecart to load: from 1 chunk radius to whatever you like!
* If and how long to keep the region a minecart was last active in loaded after it stopped moving
* Whether to save the currently loaded regions at server shutdown and reload them again at the next startup
* How frequently to check the minecart's position (can be adjusted if have another plugin that increases the maximum speed of minecarts)
* Speed below which a minecart is considered to be stationary

Designed with efficiency at its core, this plugin was developed with performance at the highest priority from the start.  
For reasonable region sizes and number of minecarts, you shouldn't see any performance issues.  
Tested with both Spigot and Paper.

title: RapidBan
description: A plugin has same functions as Litebans
body:
# RapidBan 
**Enterprise-Grade Minecraft Punishment Management System**

**A high-performance, distributed punishment management plugin for Paper 1.21+.**

Core Features

🚀 High-Performance Architecture

-   Asynchronous Database Operations - Uses HikariCP connection pool;
    all I/O operations are executed asynchronously
-   Thread-Safe Design - Dedicated thread pool for handling database
    requests without impacting server TPS
-   Local Cache - Active ban cache to reduce database queries

🌐 Distributed Synchronization

-   Multi-Server Support - Multiple servers share the same database
-   Real-Time Sync - Ban/unban operations take effect instantly across
    all servers
-   Redis Support - Optional Redis Pub/Sub or database polling

🎯 UUID-Based Ban System

-   Based on UUID instead of player name
-   Supports permanent bans, temporary bans, and silent bans
-   Automatic unban upon expiration
-   Complete undo system

🔍 IP Association Detection

-   Records players’ historical login IPs
-   Automatically detects linked (alt) accounts
-   Notifies administrators of suspicious logins
-   Optional automatic linked-account banning

🎨 Custom Kick Interface

-   Supports MiniMessage format
-   Variable placeholders (player name, reason, remaining time, etc.)
-   Different templates for different punishment types

📊 Web Management Panel

-   REST API interface
-   JWT authentication
-   View punishment history
-   Execute ban/unban operations
-   Search players and linked accounts

Database Options

SQLite (Recommended for Single Server)

-   ✅ No additional database installation required
-   ✅ Simple configuration, ready to use out of the box
-   ✅ Suitable for small servers
-   ❌ Does not support multi-server synchronization

Configuration example:

    database:
      type: "SQLITE"
      sqlite:
        file: "rapidban.db"

MySQL/MariaDB (Recommended for Multi-Server)

-   ✅ Supports distributed multi-server synchronization
-   ✅ High performance, suitable for large networks
-   ✅ Centralized data management
-   ❌ Requires a separate database server

Configuration example:

    database:
      type: "MYSQL"
      mysql:
        host: "localhost"
        port: 3306
        database: "rapidban"
        username: "root"
        password: "password"

Configuration

config.yml

    # Server identifier (used for distributed synchronization)
    server-id: "server-1"

    # Database configuration
    database:
      # Database type: MYSQL or SQLITE
      type: "MYSQL"

      # MySQL/MariaDB configuration
      mysql:
        host: "localhost"
        port: 3306
        database: "rapidban"
        username: "root"
        password: "password"

      # SQLite configuration (file path relative to plugin data folder)
      sqlite:
        file: "rapidban.db"

    # Synchronization system configuration
    sync:
      interval-seconds: 5
      use-redis: false
      redis:
        host: "localhost"
        port: 6379
        password: ""

    # IP association detection
    ip-check:
      enabled: true
      auto-ban-alts: false
      notify-staff: true

    # Web management panel
    web:
      enabled: true
      host: "0.0.0.0"
      port: 8080
      jwt-secret: "change-this-to-a-random-secret-key"
      admin-username: "admin"
      admin-password: "admin123"

Commands

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command                                       Description               Permission
  --------------------------------------------- ------------------------- -------------------------
  /ban <player> <reason> [-t <duration>] [-s]   Ban a player              rapidban.ban

  /unban <player>                               Unban a player            rapidban.unban

  /history <player>                             View punishment history   rapidban.history

  /punishundo <player> [reason]                 Undo all punishments      rapidban.undo
  
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Duration Format

-   s - Seconds
-   m - Minutes
-   h - Hours
-   d - Days
-   w - Weeks
-   M - Months
-   y - Years

Examples:

    /ban Player123 Cheating -t 7d
    /ban Player456 Abusive language -t 3h -s
    /ban Hacker999 Using hacks

Permissions

  Permission            Description
  --------------------- --------------------------------------
  rapidban.*            All permissions
  rapidban.ban          Ban players
  rapidban.unban        Unban players
  rapidban.history      View history
  rapidban.undo         Undo punishments
  rapidban.notify       Receive punishment notifications
  rapidban.notify.alt   Receive linked-account notifications

Web API

Authentication

    POST /auth/login
    Content-Type: application/json

    {
      "username": "admin",
      "password": "admin123"
    }

Response:

    {
      "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
      "username": "admin",
      "role": "ADMIN"
    }

Performance Optimization

-   ✅ All database operations executed asynchronously
-   ✅ HikariCP connection pool optimization
-   ✅ Active ban local cache
-   ✅ Dedicated thread pool for I/O processing
-   ✅ Batch query optimization
-   ✅ Automatic cleanup of expired data

Development

    # Clone the project
    git clone <repository>

    # Build
    ./gradlew shadowJar

    # Output location
    build/libs/RapidBan-1.0-Beta1.jar

License

This project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

Support

If you have any questions or suggestions, please submit an Issue.
