title: FurnanceUpgrade
description: Improving the furnance for CoinsEngine currency
body:
# FurnaceUpgrade Plugin

A plugin that allows players to upgrade furnaces using in-game currency via CoinsEngine.

## 🚀 Features

- **Furnace Upgrades**: Level up your furnace for money
- **Upgrade Effects**:
    - Increased smelting speed
    - Reduced fuel consumption
- **Support for All Furnace Types**: Regular furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers
- **Economy Integration**: Works with CoinsEngine
- **Persistent Data**: Furnace level is preserved on block break, crafting (furnace to smoker/blast furnace), and moving

## Dependencies:
[CoinsEngine](https://modrinth.com/plugin/coinsengine) - required (The plugin is tied to economics)

## 📦 Installation

1. Make sure CoinsEngine is installed
2. Download the **latest release**
3. Place the `.jar` in the `/plugins` folder
4. Restart the server
5. Configure the config file and run `/furnaceupgrade reload`

## ⚙️ Configuration

Main configuration file `config.yml`:

```yaml
# Economy settings
economy:
  currency: "money" # Name of the currency in CoinsEngine
  base-cost: 10 # Cost of the first level if cost is not set for the level
  cost-multiplier: 1.5 # How much the cost increases per level if cost is not set

# Speed and fuel consumption multipliers
base-speed-multiplier: 1.0 # Base smelting speed multiplier
speed-multiplier-per-level: 0.5 # Smelting speed increase per level
base-fuel-consumption-multiplier: 1.0 # Base fuel consumption multiplier
fuel-consumption-multiplier-per-level: 0.25 # Fuel consumption reduction per level

# Visual effects
visual:
  upgrade-sound: "minecraft:entity.player.levelup"
  upgrade-effect: "minecraft:happy_villager"

# Upgrades
upgrades:
  0:
    name: "<gray>Normal</gray>"
    cost: 0 # This level is always free
  1:
    name: "<green>Enhanced</green>"
    cost: 100
  2:
    name: "<blue>Advanced</blue>"
    cost: 250
  3:
    name: "<gold>Epic</gold>"
    cost: 500
  4:
    name: "<dark_purple>Legendary</dark_purple>"
    cost: 1000

# Furnace names and prefix
prefix: "<gradient:blue:gray>[Furnace Upgrade] |</gradient>"
furnace-name: "Furnace"
blast-furnace-name: "Blast Furnace"
smoker-name: "Smoker"

# Messages
messages:
  furnace-level-display: "<gray>{furnace} [{level-name}]"
...
```

## 🎮 Usage

### Upgrading a Furnace
1. Approach a furnace (regular, blast furnace, or smoker)
2. Make sure your hand is empty
3. **SHIFT + Right Click** - view information about the next level
4. **SHIFT + Right Click again within 5 seconds** - upgrade the furnace

### Commands
```text
/furnaceupgrade info - display info about all upgrade levels
/furnaceupgrade reload - reload the configuration (requires furnaceupgrade.reload)
```

### Permissions
```text
furnaceupgrade.reload - permission to reload the configuration
```

## 🔧 Technical Details

### Supported Furnace Types
- `FURNACE` - regular furnace
- `BLAST_FURNACE` - blast furnace
- `SMOKER` - smoker

### Data Storage
Furnace levels are stored in `PersistentDataContainer`, which allows:
- Preserving levels on block break
- Restoring levels when placed

### Economy
The plugin uses CoinsEngine to handle currency. Ensure that:
1. CoinsEngine is installed and configured
2. The currency specified in `economy.currency` exists

description: This mod adds a "realistic" way to enjoy looking at the sun.
body: [![CurseForge Versions](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/1437424.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/thedragons-mini-sun-blinded) [![CurseForge Downloads](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/short_1437424_downloads.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/thedragons-mini-sun-blinded) [![Github](https://img.shields.io/badge/Give%20a%20Star%20on%20Github-fafbfc?logo=github&logoColor=black)](https://github.com/TheDragonSkull/Sun-Blinded-Mod) --- # 📖 About **Sun-Blinded** is a small immersive mod that adds some "realism" and difficulty to Minecraft. By introducing a simple yet impactful mechanic, it turns an everyday visual detail into a gameplay element with consequences, encouraging players to think twice before exposing themselves to intense sunlight. Thankfully, not everything is doom and blindness; a pair of sunglasses might just save your eyes. --- # ✨ Features - 😎 **Wearable Sunglasses** – Equip sunglasses in the helmet slot or Curios slot for flexible compatibility and added features. - 🌞 **Sun Exposure Effects** – Looking directly at the sun comes with visual consequences. - 👁️ **Immersive Visual Filters** – Custom screen effects simulate glare, exposure, blindness. - 🕶️ **Eye Protection System** – Sunglasses help negating the sun exposure, but at a cost... - ⚙️ **Configurable Settings** - Detection radius for the sun and toggle sunglasses overlay can be changed in the *sunblinded-common.toml* config file. This mod supports multiplayer. If you find bugs please report so I can try to fix them. ❗ IMPORTANT ❗ This mod is NOT compatible with Optifine, use [Embeddium](https://modrinth.com/mod/embeddium/versions) and [Oculus](https://modrinth.com/mod/oculus/versions) instead. --- # ⚙️ How it works ### Sun Exposure Looking at the sun for up to 5s builds up sun exposure, gradually triggering visual discomfort effects instead of instant penalties. **[Detection radius be changed in the config file]** * Exposure: Staring at the sun increases exposure intensity over time, which slowly decreases once the player looks away. * Afterimage: If the player stares at the sun for more than 1 second, an afterimage is generated when they stop looking at it. Its duration and intensity depend on how long the sun was stared at. ![exposure_gif](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/541b459e-a104-4dac-8101-0a456fac2786) ### Sun Blindness Staring at the sun for a full 5 seconds applies the new Sun-Blinded effect, causing the screen to become blurry and decolored. This effect persists until the player dies or drinks milk. ![effect](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/50d3ba0d-8ccb-4cbd-b4a5-56bd3deea72c) ### Sunglasses Sunglasses are a wearable and dyeable new item that protect the player’s eyes from sun exposure and its effects, at the cost of a dark screen overlay that simulates the reduced brightness of real-life sunglasses. **[Can be disabled in the config file]** - Behavior * Can be equipped in the helmet helmet slot or in a Curios slot. * When equipped in a Curios slot, the sunglasses can be toggled up or down using a dedicated keybind. When toggled up, they behave as if they were not equipped. * Certain mobs can spawn wearing sunglasses (random color), making them immune to sunlight and causing them to drop the sunglasses upon death. * Sunglasses can also be found inside chests in: bonus chest, simple dungeons, woodland mansions, weaponsmith house and toolsmith house. ![sunglasses](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f562c799-17e9-4fdc-9f77-6051593acd8d) --- # 🛠 Recipes ## Crafting ## Dyeing (Shapeless) ## Clearing (Shapeless)(Returns Bucket) --- # 📦 Dependencies **Forge** - [Minecraft Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/) - [Curios API](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios/versions)

title: Shrinking World
description: A mod I made that shrinks the world over time from the outside in and the inside out...
body:
# Shrinking World

**The world is hunting you. Keep moving or be consumed.**

Shrinking World is a challenge mod designed for dramatic video content where the Minecraft world actively tries to destroy players. Stay still too long, mine too much, or build in one spot — and the ground beneath you will collapse into the void.

---

## 🎮 How It Works

### Pressure System
Every player has an invisible **pressure meter** (0-100) that builds when you:
- Stand still
- Mine blocks
- Place blocks

When pressure gets too high, the world begins to destabilize around you. **Keep moving to reduce pressure and escape!**

### Collapse Stages

| Stage | Pressure | What Happens |
|-------|----------|--------------|
| ✅ **Safe** | 0-59 | Nothing — you're fine |
| ⚠️ **Warning** | 60-79 | Screen warnings, ominous sounds |
| ☢️ **Instability** | 80-94 | Columns begin falling, minor damage |
| ☠️ **Collapse** | 95-100 | Massive void holes, heavy damage |

### Void Collapse
When collapse triggers, **entire columns of blocks** (including bedrock!) physically fall into the void, leaving permanent holes. This creates dramatic moments where the world literally crumbles around you.

### Escape Mechanic
You *can* escape! When you start running:
- Pressure decays much faster
- The collapse happens **behind** you, not on top of you
- Keep sprinting to outrun the destruction

---

## 📋 Commands

All commands require OP level 2. You can use `/sw` as a shortcut for `/shrinkingworld`.

### Game Control
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/sw start` | Activate the shrinking world |
| `/sw stop` | Pause the game |
| `/sw reset` | Reset all pressure and state |
| `/sw status` | Show current game status |
| `/sw debug` | Show your pressure, state, and escape status |

### Testing
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/sw pressure <0-100>` | Set your pressure level directly |
| `/sw border <size>` | Set world border size |

### Configuration
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/sw config` | Show all current settings |
| `/sw config <setting> <value>` | Change a specific setting |

### Difficulty Presets
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/sw config preset easy` | Very forgiving, great for testing |
| `/sw config preset medium` | Balanced challenge |
| `/sw config preset hard` | Punishing — keep moving! |
| `/sw config preset nightmare` | Brutal, barely escapable |

---

## ⚙️ Config Settings

All settings can be changed in-game with `/sw config <setting> <value>`:

### Pressure Settings
| Setting | Range | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `pressureGain` | 0.001-1.0 | How fast pressure builds when stationary |
| `pressureDecay` | 0.001-1.0 | How fast pressure drops when moving |
| `miningPressure` | 0-1.0 | Extra pressure from mining blocks |
| `buildingPressure` | 0-1.0 | Extra pressure from placing blocks |

### Thresholds
| Setting | Range | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `warningThreshold` | 0-100 | Pressure to trigger warning stage |
| `instabilityThreshold` | 0-100 | Pressure to trigger instability |
| `collapseThreshold` | 0-100 | Pressure to trigger full collapse |

### Escape Settings
| Setting | Range | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `escapeMultiplier` | 0.5-20 | How much faster pressure decays when escaping |
| `escapeDistance` | 1-50 | Blocks you need to move to trigger escape mode |

### Collapse Settings
| Setting | Range | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `columnsPerCollapse` | 1-20 | How many columns fall at once |
| `collapseInterval` | 10-200 | Ticks between collapse events |
| `collapseRadius` | 3-30 | How far from you columns can fall |

---

## 🛡️ Stronghold Protection

End Portal rooms are **protected** from collapse to ensure the game is always beatable. The portal frames and surrounding area won't be destroyed.

---

## 📦 Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.10
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric
- **Dependencies:** Fabric API

---

## 🎬 Perfect For

- Challenge videos and streams
- "The Floor is Lava" style content
- Speedrun variants
- Multiplayer chaos

---

## 💡 Tips

1. **Don't stop moving** — even walking slowly reduces pressure
2. **Sprint to escape** — running triggers faster pressure decay
3. **Mine and run** — grab what you need and keep moving
4. **Watch the warnings** — you have time to escape before collapse
5. **Use presets** — start with `/sw config preset medium` and adjust from there

---

title: Tree/Grower
description: Tree/Grower lets you plant and grow trees with customizable noise patterns and multiple sapling types for natural or custom forests.
body:
# Tree/Grower

**Tree/Grower** is a Minecraft mod that allows you to quickly plant multiple tree types and grow them in seconds without having to mess with tick speed!

---

## Features

- `/growtrees` – Automatically grow trees in a specified number of chunks around your position.
- `/treestop` – Stop any ongoing tree growth operations immediately.
- `/planttrees` – Plant saplings with customizable noise patterns and multiple types of trees.
- Supports multiple procedural noise types: **uniform**, **simplex**, **perlin**, and **voronoi**.
- Weighted tree selection allows for mixed forests using up to three sapling types.

---

## Commands

### `/growtrees <chunks>`  

Automatically grows trees in the specified number of chunks around the player.  

**Example:**

/growtrees 5


This will attempt to grow trees in a 5×5 chunk area centered on the player.

---

### `/treestop`  

Stops all currently running tree growth processes.  

**Example:**

/treestop


---

### `/planttrees <chunks> <amount> <noisetype> <type1> [type2] [type3]`  

Plants saplings across the specified area with advanced control.  

**Parameters:**

- `chunks` – Number of chunks around the player to plant trees in (1–24).  
- `amount` – Approximate number of trees per chunk.  
- `noisetype` – Type of procedural noise to use for tree distribution. Options:  
  - `uniform` – Trees are placed randomly with equal probability.  
  - `simplex` – Uses Simplex noise for smooth clustered placement.  
  - `perlin` – Uses Perlin noise for natural variation.  
  - `voronoi` – Clusters trees around randomly generated seed points.  
- `type1` – First sapling type (required).  
- `type2` – Second sapling type (optional).  
- `type3` – Third sapling type (optional).  

**Examples:**

- Plant 10 trees per chunk using uniform noise and only oak saplings:

/planttrees 3 10 uniform minecraft:oak_sapling


- Plant 5 trees per chunk using Voronoi noise with oak, birch, and spruce saplings:

/planttrees 6 5 voronoi minecraft:oak_sapling minecraft:birch_sapling minecraft:spruce_sapling


---

## Notes

- The actual number of trees planted may exceed the `amount` parameter depending on noise and terrain.  
- Saplings are only planted where they can survive (on solid ground, not obstructed).  
- Voronoi noise creates natural-looking clusters, while Simplex and Perlin produce smooth, flowing forest patterns.  

---

## Installation

1. Place the `Tree/Grower` mod `.jar` into your Minecraft `mods` folder.  
2. Launch Minecraft with Forge.  
3. Ensure you have permissions to use commands (creative mode or OP).  

---

## Permissions (What you're allowed to do with it)

You _are_ allowed to use this in your modpacks! Just make sure to credit the mod. The mod itself is covered under the ARR license. Redistribution or commercial use is not permitted without permission.

---

description: A Minecraft challenge mod where you’re trapped inside a 1x1 border that expend mining specific types of block
body:
Growing Box Challenge is a singleplayer Minecraft challenge mod that traps the player inside a small, expanding square border and turns progression into a block-based quest system.

You begin at Stage 0 inside a 1×1 area, with the border centered on your spawn position. At each stage, you are given a quest to break a specific type of block that exists within your current border. Completing the quest expands the playable area and advances the stage.

The border expands horizontally only, allowing the player to dig up or down freely inside the square. All progress is persistent per world, and the mod is designed specifically for singleplayer survival.

This mod is intended as a self-contained survival challenge and works out of the box with no configuration required.

title: ServerTransfer
description: A modern, secure server selector for Minecraft 1.20.5+ featuring an intuitive in-game GUI editor and seamless Transfer API integration.
body:
# ServerTransfer

ServerTransfer is a high-performance and secure server selector designed for Minecraft 1.20.5 and newer.

By utilizing the native Transfer API introduced in Minecraft 1.20.5, this plugin allows you to teleport players directly between servers in your network without the need for complex proxy configurations like BungeeCord or Velocity. It provides a polished, customizable in-game interface that makes server hopping seamless for your players.

---

### Required Setup (Important)

To enable the native transfer functionality, you must modify the configuration of all target servers in your network:

1. Open the **server.properties** file on every server.
2. Locate or add the following line and set it to true:
   `accept-transfers=true`
3. Restart your servers.

*Note: Failure to set this will result in connections being rejected when a transfer is attempted.*

---

### Key Features

**In-Game GUI Layout Editor**
Stop wasting time calculating slot numbers in a config file. Use the `/st setting` command to open a live editor. Simply drag and drop items from your inventory into the GUI. The plugin automatically saves the material, display name, and slot directly to your config.yml.

**Polished User Experience**
* **Real-time Status**: View server status (Online/Offline) and player counts directly within the item lore.
* **Visual Effects**: Includes portal particles, teleportation sounds, and action-bar countdowns.
* **Move-to-Cancel**: Automatically cancels the transfer if a player moves during the countdown to prevent accidental teleports.

---

### Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| /st | Opens the server selector GUI. | servertransfer.use |
| /st help | Displays the help menu. | servertransfer.use |
| /st setting [size] | Opens the visual GUI editor. | servertransfer.admin |
| /st reload | Reloads the plugin configuration. | servertransfer.admin |

---

### Installation

1. Download and place the **ServerTransfer.jar** into your server's plugins folder.
2. Ensure `accept-transfers=true` is set in your **server.properties**.
3. Start your server.
4. Use `/st setting` to begin building your menu.
5. (Optional) Edit `plugins/ServerTransfer/config.yml` to change the language to Japanese (`language: ja`) or fine-tune settings.

title: Hexxed's Movement Expansion (DISCONTINUED)
description: A movement mod that offers dashing and double jumping as well as a couple more enchants.
body:
## Hexxed's Movement Expansion

### THIS MOD HAS BEEN DISCONTINUED.


This mod brings the ability to dash, and double jump! You still take fall damage, so to counter that, I made two new advancement. They are only obtainable in the enchant table, or found naturally; on armor already. They do **NOT** have a enchanted book. These two enchants are - Grounded, and Gravity's Bane.

### Grounded
This enchant is a curse. It prevents you from double jumping as long as you are wearing it. I couldnt get it to prevent you from dashing, but that may come in future versions. It cannot be paired with Gravity's Bane.

### Gravity's Bane
This enchant is a very OP enchant. It is pretty rare to get. It completely negates all fall damage. There is no height limit. These can only be put on boots, and cannot be paired with feather falling. 

### Dashing
By default the keybind is set to C. This can be changed in the controls, in the movement section. This move shoots you in the direction you look. It can shoot you up, left, right, down, etc.

### Double Jumping
By default the keybind is set to Space. You can change this on the other hand, to what you prefer!
### Extra
This mod does not have any settings for you to change other than the keybinds. There are only 4 features (The 2 enchants and the 2 moves.) but will change in future versions. This was released on 11/29/2025. I am not accepting donations at this time, but may in the future. This mod does work on servers, because the dashing and double jumping are all client sided, and only affects the players dashing and double jumping.

## Enjoy the mod!




_This is my very first project. Therefore may be in beta for a while!_

_Made in MCreator_

Quality of Craft was made to add quality of life features to the game.

- Leaves - All leaves now drop apples, and percentages have been increased.
- Craftable Chainmail Armor - Use chains for the crafting recipe to get a set of Chainmail Armor.
- Craftable Name Tags - Use Quartz, String, and a Glowing Item Frame.
- Useful Rotten Flesh - Combine Rotten Flesh and String to get leather.
- Useful Rabbit Hide - Rabbit Hide can now be used to make Books and Item Frames
- Improved Mobs Drops - Mob Drops have been adjusted.
  - Wither Skeleton - Wither Skeletons drop skulls more often.
  - Enderman - Endermen now drop pearls 90% of the time, and Looting increases the count. Endermen can also rarely drop Chorus Fruits.
  - Drowned - Drowned can now drop Nautilus Shells even if they aren’t holding them. If a Drowned is holding a Trident, it will now drop a Trident on death with a 70% rate.
  - Witch - Witches can now drop one of seven Potions and can drop Slimeballs.
- More Loot Chest Drops - Some chests have been adjusted.
  - Slime Balls can be found in Jungle Temple chests.
- Revealed Hidden Advancements - All hidden advancements can now be seen on the advancements tab.
- Added Bundles (1.20 and Below) - Bundles can be crafted using String and Leather or Rabbit Hide.
Music Discs - The different music discs can be found throughout structures.
  - Blocks - Village Weaponsmith and Toolsmith
  - Chirp - Jungle Temple and Ruined Portal
  - Stal - Abandoned Mineshaft
  - Mellohi - Buried Treasure
  - Wait - Buried Treasure
  - Mall - Igloo and Jungle Temple
  - Strad - Desert Pyramid
  - Ward - Nether Fortress
  - Far - Stronghold
- Turtle Scutes - Throw a brush onto a turtle to get a bunch of Turtle Scutes. Turtle Scutes can also be found in Shipwreck chests.
- Craftable Saddles - Saddles can be crafted with leather, string, and iron ingots.

title: SwitchUtils
description: Client-side utility mod that easily switch between different armor sets via keybind.
body:
# SwitchUtils

## Overview
**SwitchUtils** is a lightweight Fabric client-side utility mod that lets you **instantly swap your entire armor set** with a single configurable keybind.  
Whether you’re switching between combat gear, mining armor, or elytra sets & this mod makes it effortless and smooth.

## Features
- **Quick Armor Switching** :: Press one key to automatically equip armor from your hotbar.  
- **Adjustable Delay** :: Choose between fixed or randomized switch intervals for natural timing.  
- **Randomization Option** :: Enable the *“Randomize Switch Delay”*  option to make each swap feel more human-like.  
- **Configurable Keybind** :: Change the swap key in keybind settings.  
- **Lightweight & Compatible** :: Works on Fabric's client-side; no server installation required.

## How It Works
1. Place your armor pieces (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots) in your hotbar.  
2. Press your **Switch Key** (`변경 트리거 키`).  
3. The mod automatically equips each armor piece in random order, with small configurable delays between each.

## Configuration
Access the config screen under:  
`Options(ESC) → Mods → SwitchUtils`

| Option | Description |
|:-------|:-------------|
| **Randomize Switch Delay** | Randomizes the armor switch delay for natural timing. |
| **Switch Trigger Key** | The keybind used to trigger armor switching. |

## Requirements
- Minecraft **1.20.1**
- Fabric Loader **1.16.10 or later**
- **Mod Menu** for configuration (Optional)

## Notes
This is a **client-side only mod**, so it’s safe to use on any server >> it only affects your local actions and visuals.

---

> ⟳ *Switch smarter, not harder*

title: YetAnotherWhitelistPlugin (YAWL)
description: Most simple whitelist plugin for Velocity server.
body: # YAWL (Yet Another Whitelist Plugin) **YAWL** is an incredibly simple, lightweight, and efficient whitelist plugin designed exclusively for the **Velocity** proxy. If you need a no-fuss, easy-to-manage whitelist solution that just works, this is the plugin for you. ## 🚀 Overview The core philosophy of YAWL is **simplicity**. In a world of complex plugins, YAWL stands out by doing one thing and doing it well. It manages a server whitelist through a plain text file (`whitelist.txt`), making it easy to view, edit, and manage without needing databases or complicated commands. It's built to be as performant and unobtrusive as possible, ensuring zero impact on your server's performance. ## ✨ Why Choose YAWL? * **⚡ Lightweight:** The plugin has a minimal footprint. It's written to be extremely efficient and won't add any bloat or lag to your proxy. * **✏️ Simple Text-Based Management:** All whitelisted players are stored in a simple `whitelist.txt` file. You can edit this file directly and reload the plugin in-game. * **⚙️ Straightforward Configuration:** A clean `config.toml` file allows you to toggle the whitelist, change message languages, and set case sensitivity with ease. * **🌍 Multi-Language Support:** YAWL comes with multiple pre-packaged languages (`en`, `ar`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `ja`, `ru`, `uk`, `zh-cn`, `pt-br`, `tr`). It can even **automatically display messages in a player's client language**\! * **🔄 Live Reload:** No need to restart your entire proxy. A simple command reloads the configuration and the whitelist instantly. * **🔒 Permissions-Ready:** Fine-grained permission nodes give you complete control over who can manage the whitelist. ## 📦 Installation 1. Download the latest version of the plugin. 2. Place the downloaded `.jar` file into the `plugins` folder of your Velocity proxy. 3. Start or restart your proxy. 4. The default configuration (`config.toml`), locales, and an empty `whitelist.txt` file will be generated in `plugins/yawl`. Edit them to your liking\! ## ⚙️ Configuration The configuration is handled in the `plugins/yawl/config.toml` file. ```toml [settings] # Enable or disable the whitelist. If false, the plugin will not kick anyone. enabled = true # Sets the language for plugin messages. # Corresponds to a file name in the 'locales' folder (e.g., "en", "ru"). locale = "en" # If true and the client has a language set that exists in the plugin's locales folder, it will be displayed. # If false, it will display default locale defined by upper setting. use-client-locale = false # If true, player names in the whitelist will be case-sensitive (e.g., "Player" is different from "player"). # If false, case will be ignored ("Player" and "player" are the same). # It's recommended to keep this 'false' for user-friendliness. case-sensitive = false # Kick active player immediately after whitelist removal or expiry. # If false, the player will remain connected until they reconnect or reload occurs. kick-active-on-revoke = true # Placeholder reload interval in minutes placeholder-reload-interval = 2 ``` ## 🆔 Placeholders Starting with version 1.2, you can use the `%yawl_duration%` placeholder, which contains the amount of time remaining for the player. To use placeholders, you need to install [YetAnotherWhitelistCompanion](https://github.com/renwixx/YetAnotherWhitelistCompanion) and [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) on your backend server(s). ## 💬 Commands All commands start with `/yawl`. | Command | Description | | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | | `/yawl` | Displays the plugin help message. | | `/yawl add ` | Adds a player to the whitelist. | | `/yawl add []` | Adds a player to the whitelist for a specific time. | | `/yawl extend [] [add\|replace]` | Adds time for a specific player. If the white list timer has expired, it will suggest replacing the time based on the actual time or adding to the old time limit. | | `/yawl remove ` | Removes a player from the whitelist. | | `/yawl list` | Shows a list of all whitelisted players. | | `/yawl reload` | Reloads the config and `whitelist.txt`. | ## 🔑 Permissions Grant these permissions to your staff groups to control who can manage the whitelist. | Permission | Description | | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | | `yawl.bypass` | Allows a player to join the server even if not on the whitelist. | | `yawl.command.add` | Allows using the `/yawl add` command. | | `yawl.command.extend` | Allows using the `/yawl extend` command. | | `yawl.command.remove` | Allows using the `/yawl remove` command. | | `yawl.command.list` | Allows using the `/yawl list` command. | | `yawl.command.reload` | Allows using the `/yawl reload` command. |

title: BoatRace
description: A simple timer and scoreboard plugin for races
body:
Please visit the [github page](https://github.com/PeterTerpe/BoatRace) for bug report and most recent updates. # BoatRace - A simple racing plugin A Java Minecraft Paper plugin that provides timers and scoreboards for races. ## How to use: 1. Setup a track using commands. 2. Players can join tracks by using /race join <name> 3. An item will be given to players, which can be used to switch their status between ready and not ready on right click 4. When all participants in the track are ready, the countdown starts and race begins afterwards 5. During countdown, participants who are outside the start region will be teleported to the spawn of the track. And if participants tried to move outside the start region while mounting a boat, the boat is removed. Player movements of participants outside the start region during countdown will be cancelled. **Caution: player position will be lowered when they mount a boat, this must be considered when setting the start region** 6. When a participant reached the finish line, their timer is sent to all participants within the same session. Their personal records and track records will be updated immediately if conditions are met. ## Dependencies: DecentHolograms (tested with v2.9.4) ## Usage: /race create # create a race track
/race setstart1 [x] [y] [z] # set start region point 1
/race setstart1 [x] [y] [z] # set start region point 2
/race setfinish1 [x] [y] [z] # set finish region point 1
/race setfinish2 [x] [y] [z] # set finish region point 2
/race delete # delete a track
/race stop # force stop a race session
/race hologram # modify track top5 scoreboard
/race check # check personal top records on specified track ## Feature list: - Per player translation - Countdown before race - Limit players who joined the race to the start region at countdown - Timer display during race - Support multiple tracks in the same world & Multiverse - Finish line message - Top5 scoreboard for each track - Personal bests records - Luckperms support ## TODO: - Configurable timezone for timestamp

description: A core shader with an easy way of adding custom animated gradients
body:
# Cool Gradients by Akis
Another simple core shader by me that lets you easily add custom ***moving*** gradients very easily
## Registering custom 
- Adding them is as easy as picking the trigger color, start color, end color, and speed:
  ```java
  void initGradients() {
    registerGradient(0xF2F2F2,0xB5070A,0xFF0A0D,5000.0);
    // Trigger Color - #F2F2F2
    // Start Color - #B5070A
    // End Color - #FF0A0D
    // Speed - 5000
  }
  ```
- You can also just use [this website](https://utils.notionsmp.org/gradient-helper/) I made!
- The current limit is 10, but you can easily up that by changing line 35:
  ```java
  Gradient gradients[10]; // make this number higher for more gradients
  ```
---

## How to install
### Nexo:
- Download the [latest version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cool-gradients-by-akis/versions) of the resource pack
- Put it into your `plugins/Nexo/pack/external_packs`
- Go into the game and run `/n rl all` to reload Nexo
- Et voilá, you're done!
### Minecraft
- Download the [latest version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cool-gradients-by-akis/versions) of the resource pack
- Put it into your `.minecraft/resourcepacks`
- Et voilá, you're done!

---

1. Copy the hex color code for your desired effect.
2. Apply it to your text in Minecraft using formatting tools or plugins.

**⚠️IMPORTANT⚠️**

This mod requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

<hr>

**Toast Entity Health Indicator** is a client-sided Minecraft mod for the **Fabric Loader**, that displays **1** toast (with a bar), upon looking at an entity. The bar in the toast, represents the health of the targeted entity, which drains/fills smoothly (when targeted entity's health changes). The toast's title will contain the name of the targeted entity. Once you look away from the targeted entity, the toast will be on-screen for 3 seconds (bar will still be updated), before disappearing.
The whole mod is toggleable with the following command: **/toggletoastdisplay** (*now only toggleable with the default key bind H*).

### **NoOpHere - Ultimate OP Protection for SMP Servers 🚫🔒**  

**NoOpHere** is a must-have security plugin for **Survival Multiplayer (SMP) servers**, ensuring that **no unauthorized player can obtain OP privileges** and preventing abuse of powerful console commands. This plugin **automatically removes OP access** and **blocks risky commands**, helping server owners maintain fair gameplay and a secure environment.  

---

## 🔥 **Key Features for SMP Servers**  

✅ **Automatic OP Removal** – Instantly removes OP from all players, even offline ones.  
👀 **Real-Time Monitoring** – Constantly scans for unauthorized OP changes.  
🚫 **Command Protection** – Blocks dangerous commands like `/op`, `/deop`, `/give`, `/tp`, `/gamemode`, etc.  
📢 **Audit Logging** – Sends alerts when someone tries to get OP access.  
⚙️ **Fully Configurable** – Customize blocked commands, alerts, and check intervals.  
🔄 **Lightweight & Efficient** – Designed for **SMP servers**, with minimal performance impact.  

---

## ⚙️ **How It Works**  

1️⃣ **Download & Install:** Place `NoOpHere.jar` into your `plugins/` folder.  
2️⃣ **Restart the Server:** The config file will be generated automatically.  
3️⃣ **Customize Settings:** Edit `config.yml` to match your server’s needs.  
4️⃣ **Stay Secure:** No more OP abuse—NoOpHere runs in the background, keeping your SMP fair and fun!

# **Project Summary**  
**Fantastisch Gepilked** is a lightweight modpack crafted to boost Minecraft's performance with powerful optimization tools ⚡ while introducing a selection of quality-of-life improvements ✨ and immersive extras 🌍. Whether you're seeking smooth gameplay on low-end hardware or enhancing the vanilla experience with practical features, this modpack has something for everyone!  

---

### **Project Description**  
**Fantastisch Gepilked** is the perfect balance between performance optimization and minor yet impactful gameplay enhancements. Here's what makes it stand out:  


<details>
<summary>Optimized for Performance</summary>


#### Say goodbye to lag and slowdowns with mods that improve how Minecraft runs:  
- **BadOptimizations**: Fixes inefficient vanilla code for faster performance. 🛠️  
- **Lithium**: Enhances server and client efficiency. ⚡  
- **Entity Culling**: Renders only what's visible to improve FPS. 🎯  
- **Dynamic FPS**: Dynamically adjusts FPS when the game is idle. 🖥️  
- **Sodium**: Overhauls rendering for better graphics and smoother gameplay. 🌈  
- **More Culling**: Adds advanced resource-saving techniques. 🔄  
- **ImmediatlyFast**: Boosts game performance across the board. 🚀 

</details>

 


<details>
<summary>Quality-of-Life Enhancements</summary>


#### Experience Minecraft with small but impactful additions that make gameplay smoother and more enjoyable:  

- **SmartBlockPlacement**: Simplifies block placement mechanics. 🧱  
- **Villager Trading Plus**: Streamlines trading with villagers for easier deals. 🤝  
- **AppleSkin**: Provides more detailed hunger and saturation info. 🍎  
- **LambDynamicLights**: Lights up the world dynamically with light sources. 💡  
- **Improved Sign Editing**: Edit placed signs with ease. ✏️  
- **Longer Chat History**: Never miss a conversation with extended chat logs. 💬  
- **FSit**: Adds the ability to sit wherever you like. 🪑  

</details>




<details>
<summary>Immersive and Visual Extras</summary>


#### Dive into a richer, more vibrant Minecraft world with these fun additions: 

- **Wavey Capes**: Enjoy realistic cape animations. 🎏  
- **Blur+**: Blurs the background in menus for a cleaner look. 🌫️  
- **3D Skin Layers**: Adds depth to player models. 👕  
- **Visuality**: Adds ambient visual effects like sparkles and particles. ✨  
- **Better Lanterns**: Enhances the look of lanterns. 🕯️  
- **cat_jam**: Brings fun and charm with a dancing cat animation. 🎵  

</details>




<details>
<summary>Practical Tools and Multiplayer Features!</summary>


#### Designed for both solo players and multiplayer fans:  

- **Simple Voicechat**: Enables proximity-based voice chat for better communication. 🎙️  
- **World Host**: Makes hosting multiplayer sessions effortless. 🌐  
- **Bobby**: Loads distant chunks for seamless exploration. 🗺️  
- **Zoomify**: Adds a zoom function for precision building or exploration. 🔍  
- **Jade**: Displays detailed block and entity information. 🐾  

</details>



---

Whether you're a builder, explorer, or redstone expert, **Fantastisch Gepilked** ensures your Minecraft experience is optimized and enhanced without straying too far from the vanilla feel. Perfect for players who value performance but want a touch of creativity and functionality!

title: Useful Commands
description: This mod adds 20 useful commands that any user can execute on your server.
body:
_This mod needs to be installed on the server to function. However, you can install it onto the client, so it will function in a single-player world, but not on public servers._

This is a mod that adds 20 useful commands that players on your server could execute at the permission level 0, so any player could execute them without cheats/OP.

Part of the commands in a screenshot:

![Some of the commands in a screenshot...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0d0189161cabf9c7b5461c8a420339a0d7e723b.png)

Here is the list of commands this mod includes (I misspelled useful [the first part of the command], as usefull for some reason, XD):

1. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentAirInfo** - Shows how many ticks of oxygen you have left.
2. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentArmorInfo** - Shows how many points of armor you have equipped.
3. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentBiomeTemperature** - Shows the temperature of the biome you're in.
4. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentDimension** - Shows the current dimension you are in (The Overworld, The Nether, or The End).
5. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentFoodInfo** - Shows how many points of Food, and Saturation you have.
6. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentHealthInfo** - Shows current H.P, and absorption H.P.
7. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentLightLevel** - Shows current light level of where you are standing.
8. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentPlayerHeight** - Shows how tall you are.
9. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentTimeIrl** - Shows the current date (mm-dd-yyyy format).
10. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentWalkSpeed** - Shows the walk speed of the player.
11. **/UsefullCommands:Events:Raid?** - Shows if there is a raid at your region, or not.
12. **/UsefullCommands:ExperienceInfo** - Shows how many experience levels you have, and how many experence points are needed to reach the next level.
13. **/UsefullCommands:ServerPlayerCount** - Shows how many players are connected to the server/world.
14. **/UsefullCommands:ShowCurrentCoordnates** - Shows current X, Y, and Z coordnates.
15. **/UsefullCommands:ShowCurrentItemsInHands** - Shows current item (and count) in your main-hand, and off-hand.
16. **/UsefullCommands:ShowCurrentXYZVelocities** - Shows current X, Y, and Z velocity (how fast you are moving).
17. **/UsefullCommands:ShowPlayerDisplayName** - Shows current display name (username) of the player.
18. **/UsefullCommands:TicksLeftOnFire** - Shows how many ticks you will be on fire for.
19. **/UsefullCommands:TicksYouHaveBeenFrozenFor** - Shows how many ticks you have been frozen for.
20. **/UsefullCommands:CurrentTime** - Shows the current time of day (there is a vanilla command that displays the time, but this one is for non-oped players, so they can access it too).

_All outputs from these commands are printed in chat._


<hr>


 **Side Features**
                             
                             

- Player respawn message (shown in Minecraft's action-bar), E.G "SandWhoop _Just Respawned!_". This also has a sound on respawn: _minecraft:entity.evoker.prepare_wololo_.

- Player death message (also shown in action-bar) E.G: "SandWhoop _Died._ You were holding  <count + item> in your main-hand, and <count + item> in your off-hand".

- Entity death sound (plays the sound: "_minecraft:entity.player.death_"), when any entity in the world/server dies.

If you want, you can support me by donating with the link on this page.

title: MoarBlockSizes
description: A basic datapack to change block's sizes to snow blocks or slabs
body:
# Moar Block Sizes
## itscoldhere & joglacraft's Moar Block Sizes datapack
Moar block Sizes is a simple datapack that allows you to easily make almost any block the size of any amount of snow layers.
## How to install
- Dowload the lastest version of the datapack on the [Releases](https://modrinth.com/datapack/moarblocks/versions) page.
- Extract the zip file.
- Open your .minecraft folder.
- Open your datapacks folder inside the world folder you want the datapack in.
- Move the file you just extracted inside that folder.
- In-game, execute `/reload`.
**Note:** Unlike other datapacks, no feedback of the datapack being active will be given (such as a sound effect or text in chat). Use the `/trigger` command and look for any completion that reads `moarblocks`.
## Usage manual
- Type `/trigger moarblocks.main` to print a text-based menu to use the datapack.
  - Use it in case you don't want to deal with commands.
- Type `/trigger moarblocks.create` to generate a new block.
  - Hold a block while executing this command to give it its texture.
  - This block has no hitbox, meaning you can phase through it.
  - Not holding anything while executing this command will generate the block with the `minecraft:stone` texture.
- Type `/trigger moarblocks.modify` to give the block a hitbox and make it 1 snow layer tall.
  - Before sending the command, type `set <number 1-8>` to set how tall the block will be.
- Type `/trigger moarblocks.kill` to remove any blocks withim a 1x1 area.
  - You will have to remove the snow left afterwards.
## List of available commands
**Note:** All commands should be run with `/trigger moarblocks.`.
- create - creates a new block. (See above for details).
- credits - Prints on chat the datapack's credits.
- help - Prints on chat the datapack's help menu.
- kill - Removes all blocks created by Moah Blocks in a 3x3 area.
- main - Prints the datapack's text based menu in case you don't want to type commands.
- modify - Modifies the height Moar Block's block you are standing on.

title: Magnus
description: A modular, high-performance, and resilient synchronization suite for Minecraft Fabric servers. Features real-time inventory sync, cross-server chat, and global player management.
body:
# Magnus (Server-Side)

![Build Status](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/KroderDev/magnus/build.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=Build)
![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1--1.21.11-brown?style=flat-square&logo=minecraft)
![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-blue?style=flat-square&logo=fabric)
![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Language-Kotlin-purple?style=flat-square&logo=kotlin)
![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/KroderDev/magnus?style=flat-square&label=Release&color=green)
[![Modrinth Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/magnus?style=flat-square&logo=modrinth&color=00AF5C&label=Modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/magnus)
[![CurseForge Version](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/v/1448049?style=flat-square&logo=curseforge&color=F16436&label=CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/magnus)
![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-4169E1?style=flat-square&logo=postgresql&logoColor=white)
![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-DC382D?style=flat-square&logo=redis&logoColor=white)
![Trivy](https://img.shields.io/badge/security-Trivy-1904DA?style=flat-square&logo=trivy)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-LGPL_v3-blue?style=flat-square)


A modular, high-performance, and resilient synchronization suite for Minecraft Fabric servers. Features real-time inventory sync, cross-server chat, and global player management.

## Features

### Core Sync
*   **Multi-Server Sync**: Syncs Inventory, Ender Chest, Health, Hunger, XP, Potion Effects.
*   **High Performance**: Uses **Redis** for sub-millisecond data retrieval.
*   **Persistence**: Uses **PostgreSQL** for permanent reliable storage.
*   **Fault Tolerance**:
    *   **Circuit Breaker**: Detects database failures automatically.
    *   **Local Fallback**: Saves data to disk if the database goes down.
    *   **Auto-Recovery**: "The Janitor" service automatically restores data when the database comes back online.

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Inventory Sync** | Core synchronization of inventory, ender chest, health, hunger, XP, and potion effects. **Enabled by default.** |
| **Global Chat** | Syncs chat messages across all servers via Redis pub/sub. Raw text format for compatibility with LuckPerms, Stylist, etc. |
| **Global Player List** | Maintains a global player count with heartbeat. Provides `/glist` command. |
| **Session Lock** | Prevents concurrent logins by locking player sessions during sync. Players are held in queue until their data is safely transferred. |

### Security

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| **Message Signing** | ✅ Enabled | HMAC-SHA256 prevents message injection attacks |
| **Auto-Generated Secret** | ✅ | 32-byte cryptographic secret generated on first run |
| **Replay Prevention** | 30 sec | Messages older than 30 seconds are rejected |
| **Payload Size Limits** | 64KB | Prevents DoS via oversized messages |
| **SSL/TLS Support** | Optional | Encrypt Redis connections |

## Configuration

Magnus requires a **PostgreSQL** database and a **Redis** instance to function.

1.  **Generate Config**: Start your server once to generate the default configuration file at `config/magnus.json`.
2.  **Edit Config**: Stop the server and open `config/magnus.json`:

```json
{
    "postgresUrl": "jdbc:postgresql://your-db-host:5432/magnus",
    "postgresUser": "your_user",
    "postgresPass": "your_password",
    "redisHost": "your-redis-host",
    "redisPort": 6379,
    "redisPass": null,
    "serverName": "survival",
    "enableInventorySync": true,
    "enableGlobalChat": false,
    "enableGlobalPlayerList": false,
    "enableSessionLock": false,
    "enableMessageSigning": true,
    "messageSigningSecret": "auto-generated-on-first-run",
    "redisSsl": false
}
```

3.  **Launch**: Restart your server. Magnus will automatically verify the connection and create the necessary database schema.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Multi-Server Setup**: Copy the `messageSigningSecret` from the first server to all other servers. All servers must use the same secret.

### Configuration Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `serverName` | `"default"` | Unique identifier for this server (e.g., `"survival"`, `"lobby"`) |
| `enableInventorySync` | `true` | Enable inventory/player data synchronization. Disable for lobby servers. |
| `enableGlobalChat` | `false` | Enable cross-server chat synchronization |
| `enableGlobalPlayerList` | `false` | Enable global player list and `/glist` command |
| `enableSessionLock` | `false` | Enable session locking to prevent concurrent logins |
| `enableMessageSigning` | `true` | Enable HMAC message signing (recommended) |
| `redisSsl` | `false` | Enable SSL/TLS for Redis connections |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/glist` | Shows total player count and players grouped by server (requires `enableGlobalPlayerList`) |

## Architecture

For detailed flow diagrams and behavior documentation:
- [Core Sync Flow](docs/core_sync_flow.md) - Data synchronization and fault tolerance
- [Global Chat Flow](docs/global_chat_flow.md) - Cross-server chat messaging
- [Global Player List Flow](docs/global_playerlist_flow.md) - Player list heartbeat and `/glist`
- [Session Lock Flow](docs/session_lock_flow.md) - Login queue and session locking
- [Message Security Flow](docs/message_security_flow.md) - HMAC signing and replay prevention
- [Server Lifecycle Flow](docs/server_lifecycle_flow.md) - Startup and shutdown sequence

title: RC Vehicles
description: "Remote-control cars and planes with a bindable remote and first-person camera"
body:
# RC Vehicles

RC Vehicles adds remote-control vehicles to Minecraft — drive cars and fly planes, either by riding them or controlling them from a distance with a handheld remote.

## Vehicles

**RC Car** — A fully drivable custom vehicle. Hop in and drive it directly, or bind a remote and control it from afar. It climbs blocks and handles uneven terrain.

**RC Plane** — Takes to the skies with realistic flight physics: build up airspeed to stay airborne, pitch up to climb and down to dive. Slow down too much and it'll stall, just like the real thing.

## The Remote

Craft an **RC Remote**, then right-click any vehicle while holding it to bind to that vehicle. Once bound, you can drive or fly it from a distance — perfect for sending a car around a corner or flying a plane overhead.

Press **V** while holding the remote to switch to a first-person camera mounted on your vehicle, so you can see exactly where it's going.

## Controls

- **Right-click** a vehicle with the remote to bind to it
- **W** — throttle / accelerate
- **S** — brake / reverse
- **A / D** — turn left / right
- **Space** — climb (plane)
- **Shift** — dive (plane)
- **V** — toggle first-person camera

## Crafting

Both vehicles and the remote are crafted with **iron and redstone**, so you can build them in survival.

## Requirements

- **Fabric Loader** + **Fabric API**
- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Must be installed on **both the client and the server**

---

*This is an early alpha release — expect rough edges and more vehicles to come!*

title: WorldBinder
description: WorldBinder is a powerful Fabric mod for saving, editing and placing structures, entities and reusable world scenes.
body:
# WorldBinder

WorldBinder is a client-side Fabric mod for capturing loaded Minecraft world data and exporting it into playable vanilla world saves.

It is designed for players, server owners, builders, developers and preservation-focused users who want to locally save world data that their Minecraft client has already received. WorldBinder focuses on world capture, export, recovery, inspection and responsible preservation tools.

WorldBinder does **not** provide cheats, combat advantages, movement advantages, X-ray features or hidden server bypasses.

---

## What WorldBinder does

WorldBinder captures world data that is already loaded on your client and turns it into a local Minecraft world save.

This can be useful for:

- backing up your own builds
- preserving maps you created or administer
- archiving server projects you have permission to save
- inspecting captured world data locally
- testing exports across different Minecraft versions
- recovering captured chunks after crashes or disconnects

WorldBinder can only save data that your client actually receives. It cannot magically reconstruct server-side-only logic, unloaded chunks or hidden data that was never sent to your game.

---

## Main features

- Client-side world capture
- HotCache-first chunk capture
- Durable chunk block cache for large captures
- Vanilla world export
- Target output version selection
- Block, block entity and entity export
- Map, stats and advancement export where available
- Server resource pack export as `resources.zip`
- Recovery and autosave tools
- Configurable performance presets
- Export validation reports
- F9 Control Center
- F10 live chunk map
- Ctrl+C chunk center coordinate copying
- Queue Dashboard / Profiler
- Dedicated WorldBinder keybind category
- German and English language support
- Responsive interface for different window sizes and GUI scales
- WorldBinder HUD notifications

---

## F9 Control Center

WorldBinder includes a central Control Center that can be opened with **F9** by default.

The Control Center gives quick access to:

- capture status
- archive progress
- recent activity
- warnings
- capture actions
- map tools
- recovery tools
- settings
- profiler / queue dashboard
- documentation and about pages

It is designed as the main hub for controlling WorldBinder without having to remember every individual menu.

---

## F10 live chunk map

The F10 map shows captured world data in real time.

It can display:

- captured chunks
- partial chunks
- queued chunks
- chunks with entities
- chunks with block entities
- warning and error states
- coverage information
- inspector tooltips
- manual chunk navigation
- follow mode and filters

You can also select a chunk and copy its center coordinate with **Ctrl+C**, making it easier to teleport to or inspect captured locations.

---

## HUD notifications

WorldBinder includes its own HUD notification system.

Important feedback can appear as clean toast-style notifications for actions such as capture status, save/export feedback, warnings and errors.

This makes WorldBinder feedback easier to see without relying only on chat messages.

---

## Durable chunk cache

WorldBinder includes a durable chunk cache for large captures.

During bigger world downloads, captured chunk block data can be written into a temporary cache under:

```text
saves/WorldBinder/.cache/
```

This helps protect captured block data during long sessions and makes large exports more reliable.

After a successful export, temporary cache data is cleaned up automatically. If Minecraft crashes or the export fails, the cache can remain available for recovery.

---

## Capture and export workflow

A typical WorldBinder workflow looks like this:

1. Join a singleplayer world or multiplayer server.
2. Open the WorldBinder Control Center with **F9**.
3. Configure the capture mode, target version and performance preset.
4. Start capturing.
5. Move through the area you want to save.
6. Use the F10 map to inspect capture coverage.
7. Export the captured data into a local world save.
8. Open the exported world in Minecraft or import it into a server setup you control.

WorldBinder is designed to keep capture and export actions visible and understandable, instead of silently writing files in the background without feedback.

---

## Target output versions

WorldBinder can export captured worlds for different target Minecraft versions.

This means you can capture with a newer client version and choose an older output version where supported. WorldBinder applies version-aware export handling for folder layout, gamerules, entities, POI data, saved data and world metadata.

Some version downgrades may still be imperfect, especially when the captured world contains blocks, entities, item data, NBT structures or resource pack content that did not exist in the selected target version.

---

## Export structure and validation

WorldBinder exports are designed to be readable as normal Minecraft world saves.

Exports may include:

- `level.dat`
- `level.dat_old`
- `session.lock`
- `icon.png`
- `region/`
- `entities/`
- `poi/`
- `data/`
- `resources.zip`
- an export `README.md`
- validation reports where available

For modern Minecraft versions, WorldBinder also writes additional saved-data and dimension-related structures where needed for better compatibility with vanilla and server import workflows.

The built-in validation system helps detect missing or suspicious export files before users assume an export is complete.

---

## Resource pack export

If the server sends a resource pack and the client has access to it, WorldBinder can export the resource pack as:

```text
resources.zip
```

WorldBinder tries to detect the currently active server resource pack, including cases where a server switches packs during gameplay or reuses an already-downloaded pack.

Resource pack export depends on what the client actually received and what the server allowed the client to download.

---

## Recovery and autosave

WorldBinder includes recovery and autosave features to reduce data loss during longer capture sessions.

This is useful when:

- the game crashes
- the server disconnects you
- Minecraft is closed unexpectedly
- a long capture session is interrupted
- you want safer capture behavior during testing

Recovery can reuse matching chunk cache data where available, which makes crash recovery safer for large captures.

Recovery does not replace careful exports, but it helps preserve captured data during unstable sessions.

---

## Performance presets

WorldBinder includes configurable performance presets to balance capture speed and game performance.

Available presets may include modes such as:

- Safe
- Balanced
- Fast
- Extreme
- Custom

Users can choose a preset depending on their system, server conditions and how aggressively they want WorldBinder to process captured data.

Advanced users can fine-tune capture limits, queue behavior, autosave timing and HUD/map behavior in the settings.

---

## Responsive interface

WorldBinder uses a responsive interface system designed to keep menus usable across different Minecraft window sizes and GUI scales.

This affects major screens such as:

- F9 Control Center
- F10 Map
- Capture screen
- Settings
- Safety and recovery options
- Performance configuration
- Profiler / Queue Dashboard
- Progress screens
- Export and finish screens

Very small windows may still appear more pixelated because Minecraft's pixel-style UI is being scaled down, but the layout is designed to remain consistent and usable.

---

## Keybinds

WorldBinder includes configurable keybinds in Minecraft's controls screen under the dedicated **WorldBinder** category.

Default bindings:

- **F6**: Start / stop world download
- **F7**: Set position 1
- **F8**: Set position 2
- **F9**: Open WorldBinder Control Center
- **F10**: Open WorldBinder Map

All keybinds can be changed in Minecraft's normal controls menu.

---

## Loader support

WorldBinder is a native **Fabric** mod.

It is built around Fabric's client-side APIs and is currently focused on providing the best possible Fabric experience.

WorldBinder does not currently support Forge, NeoForge or Quilt. Other loaders may be evaluated in the future, but they are not supported at this time.

---

## Important limitations

WorldBinder can only export data that the Minecraft client actually receives.

That means exported worlds may be incomplete if the server never sent certain data to the client, such as:

- unloaded chunks
- distant entities
- inventories
- some block entity data
- server-side-only logic
- hidden dimensions
- plugin-managed data
- custom server systems
- inaccessible resource pack content

WorldBinder exports may also differ from the original server-side world depending on server setup, custom content, resource packs, entities, dimensions, gamerules and Minecraft version differences.

WorldBinder is not a replacement for proper server backups.

---

## Responsible use

Only use WorldBinder on worlds, servers, maps, builds and resource packs that you own, administer, created yourself, or where you have explicit permission to archive or export the content.

You are responsible for how exported data is used.

title: MineCarry
description: MineCarry allows players to pick up and move most vanilla container blocks while preserving all their contents. No more breaking chests and dropping items everywhere—just grab and relocate your storage safely and easily.
body:
# MineCarry

Tired of emptying containers just to move them?
MineCarry lets you pick up and relocate most vanilla containers with everything still inside. Move your storage quickly, safely, and without the mess.

How it works

## Pick up:
Sneak (Shift) + Right Click a supported container with an empty main hand.

## Carry:
The container is stored as a special marker item in your selected hotbar slot. While carrying it, you will have a movement speed penalty.

## Place:
Sneak (Shift) + Right Click on a block face to place it back down, fully restoring its BlockState and BlockEntity NBT (including inventory).

## Supported blocks

Chests (including double chests)
Barrels
Furnaces and other vanilla container blocks
Ender Chest (inventory remains per-player, as in vanilla)
Not supported

Shulker Boxes (intentionally excluded for balance and technical reasons)
Anti-duplication / safety
The carry marker item cannot be dropped
Prevents placing infinite empty containers
Overrides vanilla interaction to avoid GUI desync and duplication issues
Notes

## Designed for Forge 1.20.1
Works in both singleplayer and dedicated servers

title: No More Brightness
description: A minimal Iris shaderpack that gently darkens Minecraft daylight so your screen feels less bright while still looking natural.
body:
![No more in ur face brightness](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29e4426b86082a5fc66aace97f3d362dc393ca31.png)

# No More Brightness

**No More Brightness** is a minimal Minecraft Iris shaderpack that makes the game slightly darker without changing the vanilla style too much.

Minecraft daytime can be very bright, especially when playing at night or in a dark room. This shaderpack lowers the overall brightness so the screen feels less harsh, while still keeping Minecraft natural, simple, and easy to recognize.

## Features

- Gently darkens Minecraft daylight
- Makes bright screens easier on the eyes
- Keeps a vanilla-like Minecraft look
- Lightweight shaderpack for Iris
- Works without PBR
- No bloom
- No custom shadows
- No reflections
- No extra visual effects
- Keeps the selected block outline visible

## Why use this shader?

Many Minecraft shaders try to make the game realistic, colorful, or cinematic. **No More Brightness** does the opposite. It is made for players who want a darker, calmer version of Minecraft without changing the game into a full realistic shader.

This is useful if you:

- Play Minecraft at night
- Play in a dark room
- Think Minecraft daylight is too bright
- Want a simple darker shaderpack
- Want a vanilla-style Iris shader with minimal changes

## Installation

1. Install Iris.
2. Download the shaderpack ZIP.
3. Put the ZIP file in your `.minecraft/shaderpacks` folder.
4. Open Minecraft.
5. Go to `Options > Video Settings > Shader Packs`.
6. Select **No More Brightness**.

## Compatibility

This shaderpack is made for the Iris shader loader.

It is designed to be simple and lightweight. It does not add PBR textures, bloom, custom shadows, reflections, or extra effects.

## Author

Made by **Pxnk0r**.

title: FoBounty
description: Let players put money on targets, hunt bounties, and claim Money rewards through a clean in-game bounty system using Vault.
body:
![Cover Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/083e9338558f93882215dc06d8ff834b9d4aacad.png)
**Let players put money on targets, hunt bounties, and claim Money rewards through a clean in-game bounty system using Vault.**

FoBounty adds a player-driven bounty loop for survival, SMP, factions, and PvP servers. Players can set bounties with `/bounty add`, browse active targets in a GUI, track claim history, and get paid automatically when a bounty is claimed.

![Main bounty GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06d5c1a07192043de864acac168f0aef06a52264.png)

## Features
- Let players create bounties with server economy money through Vault.
- Pay killers automatically when they claim an active bounty.
- Browse active targets in a 54-slot GUI with bounty totals, contributors, pagination, refresh, search, and filters.
- Sort bounties by newest, oldest, highest, or lowest so players can find the best target quickly.
- Track claim and loss history in chat or a dedicated history GUI.
- Store active bounties, contribution data, earned totals, and history in SQLite.

![Showing lore of skull in GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b080c800da0b1b542501709c961283c110b72567.png)

## Admin Tools
- Edit key settings from an admin GUI, including min/max bounty price, natural death behavior, announcements, anti-abuse options, update checker, and history cap.
- Remove active bounties with an admin command.
- Reload `config.yml` and `message.yml` without restarting the server.
- Block suspicious bounty claims by same IP, same subnet, or same FoTeams team.

![Admin Editor GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/949fed249975fb20cee44e031106b367137d0cc2.png)

## Integrations
- **Vault** - Handles economy withdrawals and bounty payouts.
- **PlaceholderAPI** - Optional, adds placeholders for current bounty and total earned values.
- **Discord webhooks** - Optional embed notifications for bounty creation, admin removal, and bounty claims.
- **FoTeams** - Optional same-team claim blocking when FoTeams is installed.
- **SQLite** - Local persistence for bounties, contributors, earned totals, and history, shaded inside plugin, no need to add seperately.

![Discord Webhook Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4e42e17528dfae9daddf56a6e422f1c2c0c6d9d.png)

## Dependencies
- **Vault** and a Vault-compatible economy plugin are needed for bounty payments.
- **PlaceholderAPI** is optional for placeholders.
- **FoTeams** is optional for same-team claim blocking.
- Built for Minecraft server API `1.21`.

## Commands
- `/fobounty` or `/bounty` - Open the main bounty GUI.
- `/fobounty add <player> <amount>` or `/bounty add <player> <amount>` - Place money on a target.
- `/fobounty history [player]` or `/bounty history [player]` - View bounty history.
- `/fobountyadmin editor` or `/bountyadmin editor` - Open the admin editor.
- `/fobountyadmin remove <player>` or `/bountyadmin remove <player>` - Remove a player's active bounty.
- `/fobountyadmin reload` or `/bountyadmin reload` - Reload config and messages.
- `/fobountyadmin version` or `/bountyadmin version` - Show the installed plugin version.

## Permissions
- `fobounty.use` - Use player commands and the bounty GUI. Default: everyone.
- `fobounty.admin` - Use admin commands and admin tools. Default: operators.

Optional Discord webhooks, PlaceholderAPI placeholders, and FoTeams claim protection are available for servers that want more automation around bounty activity.

## Placeholders
- `%fobounty_total_earned%`
- `%fobounty_total_earned_formatted%`
- `%fobounty_current_bounty%`
- `%fobounty_current_bounty_formatted%`

description: Nolann's AutoLogin is a lightweight, high-performance client-side mod that securely saves and automates your /login command on multiplayer servers.
body:
# What is Nolann's AutoLogin?

Nolann's AutoLogin is a lightweight, high-performance client-side mod that securely saves and automates your /login command on multiplayer servers.

# Features

🔐 **Secure & Client-Side**: Your passwords are stored locally on your computer inside the game's config folder. No data is ever sent to third-party servers.

🛠️ **In-Game Management**: Easily configure, view, or delete your passwords directly from the chat using commands.

🔒 **Double Confirmation**: Sensitive actions (like displaying all passwords or resetting the mod) require a second validation command to prevent accidental chat leaks or screen-sharing slips.

🌐 **Multi-language Support**: Available in multiple languages to match your game's settings. Please refer to the list below for details.


# Supported languages:

- fr_fr | Français (France)
- en_us | English (United States)
- es_es | Español (España)

# Commands

All interactions are managed using the primary **/autologin** command:


```
/autologin password set <password> [<ip>] | Saves the password for a server.
```

```
/autologin password get [<ip>] | Displays the password configured for the a server.
```
```
/autologin password remove [<ip>] | Deletes the saved password for a server.
```

```
/autologin password list [<username>] | Lists all saved servers and passwords for an account.
```

```
/autologin toggle | Toggles the mod on or off.
```
```
/autologin reload | Instantly reloads the configuration file of the mod.
```

```
/autologin reset | Permanently deletes all stored passwords and restores the mod bases settings.
```

_Note: This is a strictly client-side mod. It does not need to be installed on the server to function._
